postings.title: デリバリーソリューションアーキテクト
postings.description:
Req ID: CSQ427R266
Location: Tokyo, Japan

Databricksは、お客様がAIプラットフォームを活用して、世界で最も難しいなデータに関する課題を解決できるよう支援することをミッションとしています。デリバリーソリューションアーキテクト（DSA）は、この重要なミッションにおいて、セールスおよびフィールド・エンジニアリングチームと協力し、お客様のDatabricksプラットフォームの導入と利用拡大を加速させる重要な役割を担います。DSAとして、お客様がすでに導入を決定したDatabricksのワークロードについて、お客様がプラットフォームから最大限の価値と投資対効果を得られるよう、技術的な指導とサポートを提供し、お客様の成功を確実にします。特に、複雑な課題を抱えるお客様に対して、より重点的かつ技術的な責任を持って支援を行います。
このポジションは、技術とビジネスの両面を兼ね備えたハイブリッドな役割です。担当するお客様とユースケースにおいて、成長を推進します。ビジネス面では、お客様の意思決定者と関係を構築し、他の専門チームと連携しながら、Databricksが実行できる計画や戦略を策定・推進します。技術面ではDatabricksの全製品における、お客様導入後の技術的なリーダーとなります。組織内のあらゆるレベルの人々と、技術的な専門知識を活かしてコミュニケーションをとる能力が求められます。

あなたがもたらす影響 : 

- 戦略的アカウントにおける複雑なユースケースおよび複数のワークストリーム全体で、技術的な実行戦略を定義し、影響を与える。

- お客様のテクニカルリードやアーキテクトにとって信頼される技術アドバイザーとなり、アーキテクチャの議論をリードし、技術的な意思決定をガイドする。

- パフォーマンス、コスト、信頼性、長期的なニーズのバランスを取りながら、安全かつガバナンスの効いたスケーラブルなDatabricksアーキテクチャを設計する。

- お客様の成果を加速させる実用的なソリューション、プロトタイプ、再利用可能な技術資産を構築・実証する。

- プラットフォームの成熟度とスケーリングのニーズを予測し、セキュリティ、ガバナンス、運用の卓越性に関するベストプラクティスを確立する。

- アーキテクチャに影響を与え、デリバリーの障害を取り除き、技術的な実行をビジネス成果に結びつけることで、プラットフォームの採用と利用を促進する。

- Databricks、お客様、導入チームと連携し、リソースの調整、リスク管理、デリバリーの加速を行う。

- 同僚を指導し、組織全体で活用できる再利用可能な技術ガイダンス、フレームワーク、およびイネーブルメントに貢献する。

必要な条件/経験:

- ソリューションアーキテクト、ソリューションエンジニアリング、技術コンサルティング、プロフェッショナルサービス、データエンジニアリング、または関連する技術的役割における5年以上の経験

- 複雑な顧客のユースケースや複数のワークストリーム全体で、技術戦略やアーキテクチャに影響を与えた経験

- Python、SQL、または類似の言語における高いコーディング能力と、技術的ソリューションの構築、デバッグ、検証を行う能力

- 分散データシステム、データエンジニアリング、分析、データウェアハウジング、AI/ML、および最新のクラウドアーキテクチャに関する深い理解

- 安全でガバナンスが効き、スケーラブルかつ本番環境に対応したデータソリューションを設計した経験

- 不明確な技術的問題を解決し、トレードオフを評価し、構造化された分析や実験を通じてソリューションを検証する能力

- 技術リード、アーキテクト、および顧客のシニアステークホルダーとのアーキテクチャ議論をリードした経験

- セキュリティ、ガバナンス、パフォーマンス、信頼性、コスト最適化など、プラットフォームの運用上の卓越性に関する深い理解

- 技術的リーダーシップを通じて、顧客の採用、利用、そして測定可能なビジネス成果を促進した実績

- 強力なステークホルダーマネジメントおよび部門横断的なリーダーシップスキル（正式な権限なしでチームを調整する能力を含む）

- コンピュータサイエンス、工学、または同等の分野における学士号

- 日本語の完全な専門的習熟度が必須

望ましい経験/スキル

- Databricksの経験または認定資格

- AI/ML、データエンジニアリング、ストリーミング、データウェアハウジング、ガバナンス、マイグレーションなどの技術分野における専門知識の構築

- AWS、Azure、またはGCPおよび本番環境でのクラウドデプロイメントの経験

- チーム全体で活用できる、再利用可能な技術フレームワーク、デモ、またはイネーブルメント（支援策）を作成した経験

- ビジネスレベルの英語力があれば尚可

選考プロセス: Recruiter Screen → Hiring Manager Screen → Design & Architecture → Vibe Coding → Build, Demo & Delivery → Reference Check

出張: 必要に応じて最大30%程度

postings.title: Account Executive
postings.description:
As an Account Executive your mission will be to help further build our India business, which is one of our fastest growing markets in APJ. The Databricks Sales Team is driving growth through strategic and innovative partnership with our customers, helping businesses thrive by solving the world's toughest problems with our solutions. You will be inspiring and guiding customers on their data journey, making organisations more collaborative and productive than ever before. You will play an important role in the business in India, with the opportunity to strategically build your territory in close partnership with the business leaders. Using your passion with technology and drive to build, you will help businesses all across India reach their full potential, through the power of Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.

You know how to sell innovation and change and can guide deals forward to compress decision cycles. You love understanding a product in-depth and are passionate about communicating its value to customers and partners. Always prospecting for new opportunities, you will close new accounts while growing our business in existing accounts.

The impact you will have:

- Prospect for new customers

- Assess your existing customers and develop a strategy to identify and engage all buying centres

- Use a solution approach to selling and creating value for customers

- Identify the most viable use cases in each account to maximise Databricks' impact

- Orchestrate and work with teams to maximise the impact of the Databricks ecosystem on your territory

- Build value with all engagements to promote successful negotiations and close

- Promote the Databricks enterprise cloud data platform

- Be customer-focused by delivering technical and business results using the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform

- Promote Teamwork

What we look for:

- You have previously worked in an early-stage company and you know how to navigate and be successful in a fast-growing organisation

- 5+ years of sales experience in SaaS/PaaS, or Big Data companies

- Prior customer relationships with CIOs and important decision-makers

- Simply articulate intricate cloud technologies and big data

- 3+ years of experience exceeding sales quotas

- Success closing new accounts while upselling existing accounts

- Bachelor's Degree

postings.title: Account Executive - Digital Native
postings.description:
SLSQ128R18

As part of our accelerating growth, Databricks is looking for a dynamic Digital Native Account Executive to join our team in Seoul, Korea. In this role, your primary mission will be to identify, acquire, and expand business opportunities within Korea’s most innovative digital native companies, including high-growth startups, scale-ups, and tech unicorns.

You know how to navigate the fast-paced buying cycles of modern engineering cultures, understand complex tech stacks in-depth, and clearly articulate business and architectural value to both technical leaders and executive stakeholders. You will work closely with cross-functional teams and ecosystem partners to deliver tailored solutions that address high-scale data and AI challenges, closing new accounts while expanding usage within existing customers.

You will report to the Director of Sales, Korea.

The impact you will have:

- 

Evangelize the Databricks Data + AI Platform across the Korean Digital Native ecosystem, establishing Databricks as the foundational standard for modern data and GenAI workloads.

- 

Prospect, identify, and qualify new pipeline opportunities independently and in collaboration with the Databricks BDR team.

- 

Drive end-to-end sales motions from initial contact to contract closure, compressing decision cycles through value-driven validation.

- 

Establish strong relationships with C-level and key technical decision-makers, including CTOs, Heads of AI/ML, and VP-level Engineering and Data Architecture roles.

- 

Execute a land-and-expand strategy by driving platform consumption, identifying new high-impact data use cases, and steering renewals/upsells within won accounts.

- 

Orchestrate internal technical resources (Solutions Architects, Customer Success) and cloud ecosystem partners (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) to maximize sales velocity and customer value.

- 

Exceed individual activity, pipeline generation, and annual revenue targets while building a scalable territory plan.

What we look for:

- 

5+ years of software/cloud sales experience selling enterprise software, SaaS, or consumption-based PaaS solutions to the Korean market, with an emphasis on digital native/tech sector accounts.

- 

Proven track record of exceeding quota in complex sales cycles, selling data, analytics, cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML platforms.

- 

Strong command of structured sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, Value Selling, Command of the Message).

Deep understanding of the Digital Native buying process, modern engineering mindsets, and developer/architect evaluation criteria.

- 

Demonstrated ability to navigate consumption/usage-based business models and partner co-selling strategies.

- 

Exceptional ability to translate complex technical architectures into compelling business outcomes.

- 

Native-level fluency in Korean and professional working proficiency in English.

postings.title: Account Executive - Enterprise Core
postings.description:
SLSQ128R130

As an Enterprise Core Account Executive, your mission will be to nurture, retain, and systematically expand relationships across a dedicated portfolio of Databricks’ established mid-to-large enterprise accounts in Korea, spanning Financial Services (FSI), Manufacturing, Retail, and other core industries.

This role is centered on deep account nurturing and long-term value realization within existing enterprise customers. You will act as a trusted business advisor who guides customers through their data and AI maturity journey—driving platform adoption, accelerating workload consumption, and expanding the Databricks Data + AI Platform across new business units and use cases. Working closely with Solutions Architects, and local ecosystem partners, you will turn initial deployments into mission-critical, enterprise-wide standards. You will report to the Director of Sales, Korea.

The Impact You Will Have:

- 

Nurture, retain, and grow total annual contract value (ACV), consumption revenue, and net revenue retention (NRR) within a portfolio of major Korean mid-to-large enterprise accounts, including leading financial institutions.

- 

Develop and execute tailored account growth and nurturing plans that align Databricks capabilities directly with each customer’s business priorities and digital transformation roadmaps.

- 

Deepen adoption within existing accounts by uncovering new data, analytics, and generative AI use cases across different departments, divisions, and affiliated entities.

- 

Build and maintain multi-threaded relationships from technical champions (Data Engineering, Platform, Architecture, and AI/ML leads) up to senior executive stakeholders (CIO, CDO, CTO, and line-of-business heads).

- 

Partner closely with Partner team, Solutions Architecture, and FDE teams to ensure smooth onboarding, high platform health, and continuous consumption growth (DBUs).

- 

Lead contract renewals, expansion proposals, and multi-year commitment structures while navigating enterprise procurement and governance requirements (including financial regulatory compliance where applicable).

- 

Collaborate closely with domestic System Integrators (SIs) and Cloud Hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) to co-deliver value and scale platform usage across your accounts.

What We Look For:

- 

7+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, managing and growing mid-to-large enterprise accounts in South Korea (experience with Financial Services or regulated enterprise accounts is a strong plus).

- 

Proven track record of customer nurturing, account expansion, upselling, and closing complex multi-year cloud, PaaS, or enterprise software agreements.

- 

Strong expertise in consumption-based business models, workload migration, and guiding customers through cloud and data modernization.

- 

Proficiency in disciplined sales and account management frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, Value Selling, Account Planning).

- 

Demonstrated ability to orchestrate cross-functional internal teams (Pre-sales, Customer Success, FDE, Professional Services, Legal) to drive high customer satisfaction and retention.

- 

Solid experience collaborating with Korean SI partners and major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) within existing enterprise accounts.

- 

Native-level fluency in Korean is required and fluent, professional business English is preferred.

postings.description:
GAQ327R291

Accounting Data & Technology Manager

About the Role

We are building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve — leveraging AI, automation, and modern tooling to operate at the pace Databricks demands. We are seeking an Accounting Data & Technology Manager to join our Global Accounting team and serve as the architect of the redesign of our accounting processes by building automation solutions and managing data pipelines that power our global accounting organization. You will serve as the accounting team's S/4HANA expert — the person who ensures our in-flight SAP implementation reflects best practice rather than a lift-and-shift of how we operate in NetSuite today.

You will be responsible for bridging the gap between our team's subject matter experts, our technology solutions, and the business data needed to support accounting operations. In addition to SAP ownership, this role will build purposeful, reliable solutions on top of the Databricks platform and Finance Datalake to accelerate global accounting operations.

During the SAP implementation, you will work alongside our system integrator to challenge design decisions, identify where SAP's native capabilities can replace manual workarounds, and ensure the accounting team is building on the right foundation from day one. 

Post go-live, the role transitions to continuous improvement — owning automation opportunities, streamlining close processes as SAP capabilities evolve, and ensuring Databricks is getting progressively more value out of the platform over time rather than running it as a static system. 

This is a rare opportunity to shape a major ERP platform from day one at one of the world's fastest-growing technology companies, with the autonomy to define how SAP works for accounting at Databricks — and how it connects to the most advanced data and AI platform in the market.

What You'll Do

SAP Implementation Governance (Near-Term)

- Work alongside our system integrator as the accounting team's internal SAP S/4HANA subject matter expert throughout the implementation program.

- Challenge design decisions and configuration choices — ensuring they reflect SAP best practice rather than replicating current-state NetSuite processes.

- Identify where SAP's native capabilities (standard workflows, automated postings, embedded analytics, Fiori apps) can replace manual workarounds and custom development.

- Own the accounting team's requirements, testing, and sign-off for SAP configuration across core FICO areas — general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, and close management.

- Partner with our system integrator, IT and Finance Transformation to ensure data migration, chart of accounts design, and master data governance meet accounting's needs.

Continuous Improvement & Optimization (Post Go-Live)

- Own the SAP continuous improvement roadmap for accounting — identifying automation opportunities, process simplifications, and new SAP capabilities as they are released.

- Streamline close processes within SAP — driving adoption of native automation, reducing cycle time, eliminating manual steps, and improving data quality with each close cycle.

- Monitor system performance and proactively address configuration issues, data quality gaps, and process bottlenecks.

- Collaborate with Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Accounts Payable, Revenue, and Procurement to ensure SAP configuration supports end-to-end finance processes — not just accounting in isolation.

- Ensure SOX-relevant system controls (automated, access and change management controls) within SAP are properly configured, documented, and operating effectively.

SAP × Databricks Platform Integration

- Own the design and governance of how SAP accounting data flows into the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform — ensuring clean, timely, and well-structured data for financial reporting, analytics, and AI use cases.

- Partner with Data Engineering and Finance Systems to define the SAP-to-Databricks integration architecture — including extraction patterns, data models, and refresh cadences that support close timelines and ad-hoc analysis.

- Identify opportunities to leverage Databricks' AI and automation capabilities on top of SAP data — such as anomaly detection on journal entries, predictive accruals, automated reconciliation matching, and natural-language reporting via Genie.

- Serve as the accounting team's voice in shaping how Databricks' own platform is used for internal finance operations — ensuring the company is a best-practice reference customer for its own technology.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of progressive experience in accounting systems, ERP administration, or finance technology — with deep, hands-on SAP S/4HANA FICO experience.

- Demonstrated expertise in SAP S/4HANA configuration across core accounting areas: general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, and financial close and consolidation.

- Experience participating in or leading at least one full-cycle SAP S/4HANA implementation — ideally on the business/functional side rather than purely technical.

- Strong understanding of accounting close processes, U.S. GAAP, and how ERP configuration decisions impact financial reporting.

- Experience with SAP master data governance, chart of accounts design, and configuration documentation.

- SOX experience — understanding how system controls, access management, and segregation of duties operate within SAP.

- Ability to translate between accounting business requirements and SAP technical configuration — comfortable working with both accountants and technical consultants.

- Strong communication skills — able to articulate system design trade-offs to senior finance leadership clearly and concisely.

- High ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently without constant direction.

Preferred Qualifications

- SAP S/4HANA certification (e.g., SAP Certified Application Associate — Financial Accounting).

- Experience with SAP Central Finance, SAP Analytics Cloud, or SAP BTP.

- CPA, CA, or equivalent professional accounting certification.

- Experience working at a high-growth technology or SaaS company.

- Prior experience working on SAP implementations.

- Familiarity with NetSuite (helpful for understanding the current-state processes being migrated).

- Experience with Databricks or other data platforms.

- Public accounting experience (Big 4 or equivalent).

Why This Role

- Shape SAP from day one — you are not inheriting a legacy system. You will define how SAP works for accounting at Databricks, with the authority to ensure it is built right the first time.

- Challenge, don't just configure — this role exists specifically to push back on "that's how we've always done it" and ensure the implementation reflects what SAP can do, not what NetSuite did.

- Own the platform long-term — this is not a project role. Post go-live, you will own continuous improvement, automation, and system operations — ensuring Databricks gets progressively more value from SAP over time.

- Build on the Databricks platform — this is not a typical ERP role. You will define how SAP connects to the most advanced data and AI platform in the market, shaping how accounting data is used for reporting, analytics, and AI-driven automation. Few finance roles anywhere offer this combination.

- Work at the intersection of accounting and technology — partner with a world-class finance team, a leading SI, and Databricks' own engineering organization to build something exceptional.

- Grow your career — gain deep exposure to global accounting operations, finance transformation, and enterprise technology at one of the world's fastest-growing companies.

GAQ327R240

We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve — maximizing self-serve AI capabilities while driving an AI-first automation roadmap to operate at the pace Databricks demands. The Accounting Manager, Accounts Receivable, will serve as a senior individual contributor owning end-to-end technical AR accounting across global AR balances and multiple legal entities, leading multi-entity subledger consolidations as our global footprint expands. Working within a structured preparer/reviewer framework in close partnership with the broader Order-to-Cash (OTC), Revenue, and Finance Transformation teams, this high-ownership role bridges technical accounting rigor with cross-functional operational scale. 

Close quality, accurate management reporting, and subledger integrity are non-negotiable. Success in this role requires both strong operational execution and sound technical accounting judgment - applying U.S. GAAP to complex global receivables matters, bad debt modeling, and close accruals to ensure an audit-ready subledger. You will own a high-quality close today while directly shaping how our global receivables accounting operates tomorrow, using an AI-first automation mindset to scale our processes alongside rapid company growth.

The impact you will have: 

- Own the Global AR Month-End Close: Autonomously lead the monthly close cycle for Global AR balances, preparing end-to-end subledger-to-GL reconciliations, roll-forward schedules, unbilled revenue, deferred revenue adjustments, contra-AR, complex close accruals, and AR management reporting with clear analysis of material movements and key drivers.

- Technical Accounting & AFDA Modeling: Own the Allowance for Doubtful Accounts (AFDA) and Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) accounting models; assess underlying assumptions and portfolio trends, prepare monthly provision recommendations, process approved write-offs with full audit trails, and ensure technical U.S. GAAP compliance

- Lead AI & Automation Adoption: Lead the identification, design, and adoption of AI and automation opportunities across AR accounting workflows, leveraging Databricks, LLMs, and advanced analytics to automate manual reconciliations, improve accrual accuracy, strengthen controls, and accelerate period closes.

- Maintain Balance Sheet Integrity: Own AR subledger integrity, flux analyses, variance explanations, and period-over-period movement schedules, providing clear management insights into AR trends, material movements, and key balance sheet drivers for senior Finance leadership.

- Drive Audit Readiness & SOX Controls: Maintain audit-ready workpapers and process documentation; serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors regarding AR schedules, walkthroughs, and audit request responses.

- Cross-Functional Process Alignment: Partner with Billing Operations, Cash Applications, Revenue Assurance, Revenue Accounting, Corporate Accounting, and FP&A teams to validate subledger accuracy, clear unapplied balances, and reconcile AR balances.

- Finance Transformation & SAP Implementation: Partner with our Transformation, Engineering, and IT teams to redesign AR accounting workflows, eliminate manual routines, and drive process standardization, automation, testing, and data readiness for SAP and other systems implementations.

What we look for:

- Experience: 6+ years of progressive AR and GL accounting experience in a mid-to-large organization, with demonstrated ownership of month-end close, AFDA/CECL, subledger-to-GL reconciliations, and AR management reporting.

- Credentials: CPA strongly preferred. Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance.

- Technical Accounting: Strong U.S. GAAP judgment and ability to independently research, document, and defend accounting conclusions relating to receivables, revenue recognition alignment, accrual cut-off, contract assets/liabilities, and expected credit loss methodologies.

- Autonomy & Review Readiness: Proven ability to operate independently with high autonomy, producing clean, reviewer-ready workpapers within a preparer/reviewer/approver framework.

- Systems & ERP: Hands-on ERP experience (SAP, NetSuite, or similar) with the ability to query, reconcile, and validate data across subledger and GL modules.

- M&A & Integration Experience: Prior experience supporting the accounting workstream of an acquisition is a strong plus. Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving integration environments with evolving data, processes, and systems is essential.

- The Automation Mindset: Advanced Excel proficiency (Power Query, dynamic arrays) paired with hands-on experience deploying or evaluating AI tools in a finance context; familiarity with data platforms like Databricks is a strong plus. 

- Ownership & Mindset: High ownership, detail-oriented, fast-moving, direct communicator, and calm under pressure. Open-minded and change-oriented.

- Scale & Agility: High-growth technology or SaaS industry experience strongly preferred; exposure to recurring or usage-based billing models is an advantage. Public accounting background preferred.

postings.description:
GAQ427R224

We're hiring an AI Automation Engineer to build the next generation of IT automations to improve the employee experience at Databricks.

You'll be building production-grade AI agents and automation services that understand employee requests, retrieve enterprise context, reason across systems, invoke tools and APIs, and take action safely. The goal isn't to automate existing workflows the same way we've done it for the past decade. It's to reimagine how employees interact with IT through intelligent, contextual, and increasingly agentic experiences and to do it on Databricks.

What you will do

- Build AI agents and automations: Design, deploy, and run AI agents that support all of our employees. The agents interpret natural-language requests, gather context, select tools, execute actions, and communicate outcomes.

- Maintain MCP servers across our AI tools portfolio.

- Build agentic workflows that decompose goals into steps, handle failures, pause for human approval as needed, and resume their workflows.

- Ground agents in trusted internal knowledge (policies, runbooks, system documentation, SOPs, etc).

- Turn high-volume support CUJs into self-service experiences: Identify repetitive, high-friction IT interactions and convert them into reliable AI automation experiences.

- Instrument AI automations with logs, metrics, and feedback loops.

- Design and implement AI automations with identity governance, tools RBAC, human-in-the-loop approvals where applicable, audit trails, and failure handling.

- Create shared automation infrastructure (credential vaults, event ingestion, scheduling, approval workflows, cache/state stores) that other teams can build on.

- Work with IT Support, Employee Experience, Security, IAM, Infrastructure, and Engineering to identify automation opportunities and take solutions from prototype to production.

- Write and maintain high-quality technical/engineering documentation that clearly communicates system designs, operational procedures, and architectural decisions.

What we are looking for

- Proficiency in Python or Go [3yrs].

- Experience with Git-based development, automated testing, and CI/CD.

- Strong experience with REST APIs, OAuth2/authentication frameworks, event-driven integrations, and enterprise system integrations.

- Shipped production LLM-powered applications or AI agents.

- Experience with agent patterns: tool/function calling, multi-step workflows, context management, RAG, structured outputs, and plan decomposition.

- Understanding of LLM failure modes: hallucination, incorrect tool use, ambiguous intent, prompt injection, excessive permissions, and non-deterministic behavior.

- Experience evaluating and improving AI systems using automated evals, traces, test datasets, human feedback, or similar approaches.

- Ability to translate ambiguous employee friction problems into simple, reliable technical solutions.

- Strong judgment around security, privacy, least privilege, and safe automation in an enterprise environment.

- Strong collaboration and communication skills. You will work cross-functionally to plan, design, and implement automation together.

- Experience with automation or integration platforms (Tines, MuleSoft, Workato, etc.).

- Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) server development.

- Experience building agents on Databricks (Agent Bricks) or with frameworks such as OpenAI Agents SDK or LangGraph/LangChain.

SLSQ427R457

We are looking for a Director, AI Sales (IC) to grow Databricks’ enterprise AI business and shape how we take AI to market. You will work directly with executives and technical teams to win strategic opportunities, get AI applications into production, and expand customer usage. You will also turn what works with customers into sales plays the broader field can execute, with direct influence on our AI product priorities and go-to-market strategy.

The impact you will have

- Deliver assigned AI consumption, bookings, and activation goals by prioritizing high-potential strategic accounts and converting underserved or unactivated demand into production usage.

- Increase the number of enterprise AI opportunities that achieve executive-backed technical validation and progress from experimentation to repeatable production workloads.

- Build and scale field plays around priority AI platform capabilities including AI Gateway, AI/ML training and serving infrastructure, Agent Bricks for custom agent development, etc. Creating measurable pipeline and consumption growth.

- Improve field execution by equipping and enabling account teams and specialists with repeatable guidance on AI use-case discovery, qualification, value articulation, pricing, sizing, and opportunity progression.

- Establish a scalable engagement model across sales, solutions architecture, business-unit enablement, and partners that increases specialist-influenced pipeline and accelerates customer decisions.

- Turn customer, field, and competitive feedback into clear product and go-to-market recommendations that strengthen Databricks’ position in the enterprise AI market.

- Build internal and external executive credibility for Databricks AI, increasing strategic sponsorship and expanding adoption across priority accounts.

- Highly motivated enterprise sales or consulting experience in AI platforms, AI infrastructure, machine learning, developer platforms, or related technical software, with a track record of delivering growth against measurable goals.

- Experience creating go-to-market strategy in an emerging or ambiguous technical market, including the ability to prioritize across a broad, changing account and opportunity landscape.

This role will lead in expanding Databrick’s mindshare in the non-technical C-suite and overall share of wallet, leading to owning both the platform conversation and transformation mandate.

Objective of the role:

- Position Databricks as a strategic AI transformation thought partner to the C-suite, in addition to our established status as a tech partner to their organizations

- Establish trusted advisor status with LoB/functional leaders (e.g., CFO, CMO, etc.), advising on connecting LoB’s key outcomes and capabilities to specific technical use cases and solutions

- Operationalize seamless execution of the identified transformation objectives with customer teams, partners, and Databricks

- Lead the creation and activation of a select group of external AI Transformation leaders to serve as an Expert Advisory Council / C-suite user group

Responsibilities:

- For a limited group of the highest priority customers:

- Develop deep C-suite/SVP+ relationships at the customer & their main SIs and other strategic partners, execute on co-sell

- Co-create the AI Transformation Roadmap

- Ensure the successful translation of the roadmap from concept to deployment, and value realization by partnering with the FDE team and SIs

- For the broader customer set:

- Develop the engagement model with C-suite leaders, including programs/materials based on the above customer successes for wider enablement and repeatable execution

- Develop co-sell motions with strategic SIs and MBB/B4 consulting partners

- Develop scaled operating models with the FDE team and SIs to execute on transformations

- Cultivate broad Databricks and personal credibility within the target industry segment or LoB function in Databrick’s status as a trusted thought partner in AI transformation / scaled adoption and develop Databrick’s C-suite transformation narrative

- Develop and lead C-suite workshops to engage customer leadership on their AI transformations

- For Databricks:

- Identify, recruit, and engage recognized external C-suite leaders and visionaries in AI Transformation to form an Expert Advisory Council 

- Lead the activities of the Council to provide strategic guidance and operational insights into leading-edge AI Transformation capabilities

- At least 15 years of experience in digital/AI transformation in enterprises, either as an operator or consultant, with demonstrated successes in creating, architecting, leading, and scaling large-scale transformation mandates

- At least 5 years experience in working directly with enterprise C-suite to lead and execute against such transformations; built trusted relationships with these senior stakeholders

postings.title: Alliance Director
postings.description:
SLSQ427R333

You will serve as the business development engine for Databricks' Gold-tier and Rising Silver partner portfolio in EMEA, owning the motions that convert partner relationships into partner-sourced pipeline and consumption growth. Your primary mandate is intentional market-making: moving partners from delivery-first behaviour into structured demand creation through Big Bet account engagements, joint GTM campaigns, Brickbuilder solution plays, and scalable co-sell execution. You will work closely with Partner Sales Managers (PSMs), Partner Solutions Architects (PSAs), as well as Partner and Field Marketing to plan, execute, and advance partner GTM and to build the GTM capability within partners that makes this motion repeatable. You will report to the EMEA Partner Manager Leader.

The impact you will have: 

- You will own the business development motion for a defined portfolio of Gold-tier and Rising Silver partners in EMEA, co-developing structured GTM plans with the partners that drive partner-sourced pipeline volume (early-stage opportunity creation) and velocity aligned to the partner-sourced contribution targets.

- You will lead a targeted number of partner industry workshops per partner per year and run a defined number of structured partner GTM campaigns per quarter, moving partners from opportunistic co-selling to programmatic, campaign-driven demand generation aligned to Company and GTM Priorities.

- You will translate the Databricks Brickbuilder program into live partner GTM plays — identifying the right use cases, qualifying partners for Specialization and Brickbuilder eligibility, and connecting partner solution IP to Databricks sales programs and customer outcome maps for the key industries.

- You will execute the Power-of-3 motion (SI + ISV + Cloud) within your partner portfolio, brokering joint account engagements that combine your partners industry depth with cloud hyperscaler funding, and ISV capability to create multi-workload, multi-year customer outcomes.

- You will build GTM capacity inside your partner portfolio — driving sales badge completion, sales masterclasses, partner champion development, and Specialization progression — moving partners from certified to market-making, with the goal that each priority partner has a dedicated Databricks GTM team operating at the Databricks field standard.

- You will own the partner-facing governance model for your portfolio: Plan-on-a-Page and Partner Cockpit discipline, deal registration and SLA compliance, cadenced partner business updates, and the CRM hygiene that ensures partner-sourced and delivery pipeline is correctly marked and credited.

- You will run co-marketing investment decisions for your portfolio (MDF, Accelerate, co-sponsored demand gen), applying ROI discipline — strategic impact over activity volume — aligned to the principle that investment is intent, not incremental spending.

- You will operate as a Partner First leader in the field, treating priority partners as extensions of the Databricks sales team: setting accountability expectations, recognizing and scaling what works, and being the first call for partners who are creating net-new pipeline in accounts.

What we look for:

- Partner business development or channel sales experience: a demonstrated track record of driving partner-sourced or partner-initiated pipeline — not just co-sell support — with tangible evidence of moving a partner from reactive delivery to proactive demand creation.

- Campaign and programmatic GTM execution: experience designing and running structured joint campaigns with partners, not one-off events; ability to connect partner solution IP (e.g. Brickbuilder-style accelerators) to sales programs and customer outcome narratives.

- Partner portfolio management: experience managing a defined portfolio of regional or national SIs, selecting and prioritizing partners by commercial fit and growth potential, and building Joint Business Plans that produce measurable sourced pipeline outcomes.

- Operational rigor: comfort owning deal registration hygiene, KPI/OKR tracking (sourced, conversion, campaign attribution, etc.), pipeline review cadence, and partner governance (Plan-on-a-Page, Cockpit, etc.) with the discipline to keep metrics correct, analyze, using AI tools in your daily work, and act on what the data shows.

- Cross-functional collaboration: ability to work across PSM, PSA, Field Marketing, and Field Sales and Pre-Sales Leaders, to qualify, advance, and close partner-sourced opportunities. Experience navigating Sales and partner team alignment around co-sell priorities and partner accreditation.

- Value selling and partner enablement: ability to help partners build an outcome-focused, industry-specific narrative for C-suite and LoB buyers — not just pitch the platform — and to run sales masterclasses and capability sessions that improve partner sales confidence and conversion.

- Domain knowledge: understanding of mid-tier SIs' business models, how their P&L is structured, and what "partner-sourced" means operationally in their context; awareness of the EMEA data/AI competitive landscape, including the hyperscaler dynamics (AWS, Microsoft, GCP) that shape partner investment decisions.

- Ambition and execution pace: comfort operating in a high-growth, fast-moving environment where the operating model is still being built, and contributing to building it. The ability to move fast on Big Bet account engagements and campaigns without waiting for perfect conditions.

postings.description:
P-1439

As Applied ML/AI Engineer at Databricks, you will define and create the Agentic Machine Learning revolution. You will help world’s largest companies build and deploy massive classical machine learning solutions (such as personalized recommendations, fraud detection, dynamic pricing, forecasting) fully using Databricks’ agents and harnesses. After 30 years of painfully slow progress, expensive knowledge acquisition and tedious processes in classical ML, the agentic era has ushered innovation, scale and visibility for all: from the most junior data scientists and machine learning engineers to the world class experts. You will work on Databricks’ Genie Code, an agent and an ML “exoskeleton” that is authoring ML, training and deploying models, monitoring and self-healing production ML, all at the top-expert level. Additionally, you will develop ML solutions that under the hood address the most pressing questions non-technical business people have today: predictive and what-if questions.

Your work is a top priority for Databricks and you will report to a Principal Software Engineer (a Director level position).

The impact you will have:

- Build agentic end-to-end systems in a small, highly international team of experienced engineers in a flat and agile organization.

- Build solutions for people like you: software engineers, ML engineers, data engineers, data scientists and MLOps engineers.

- Own our applied ML investment by engaging with engineering and product teams across the company.

- Drive the development and deployment of state-of-the-art ML/AI models and systems that directly impact the capabilities and performance of Databricks’ products, infrastructure, and services.

- Architect and implement robust, scalable ML infrastructure, including model training and serving components to support seamless integration of AI/ML models into production environments.

- Work on novel forecasting techniques.

- Possibilities to contribute to the broader AI community by presenting at conferences and actively participating in open source projects, enhancing Databricks’ reputation as an industry leader.

What we look for:

- 2-8 years of engineering experience in high-velocity, high-growth companies. Infrastructure and system engineers with no ML background and willingness to excel in personal growth are welcome to apply.

- Strong software engineering skills, and familiarity with software engineering principles around testing and deployment.

- Experience developing AI/ML systems at scale in production and a strong track record of ML modeling that goes beyond using standard libraries is a plus.

- Nice to have: experience deploying, scaling, and monitoring models in production; understanding of the unique infrastructure challenges posed by training and serving predictions in Tier 0 environments.

Why Join Us?

At Databricks, we are building state-of-the-art AI solutions that redefine how users interact with data and our products. You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of AI-driven products at Databricks, work with cutting-edge models, and collaborate with a world-class team of AI and ML experts.

This role will focus on building our relationships with venture capital and private equity firms and turn those relationships into measurable value for their portfolio companies and Databricks. You will define the market, earn trust with investment and platform teams, and create repeatable ways to introduce founders and operators to the right Databricks teams through programs and solutions.

This is a hands-on ecosystem role with a commercial mandate. You will work across Startups, Sales, Field Engineering, Marketing and partner teams to help early-stage companies build on Databricks and help PE-backed businesses advance their data and AI priorities. You will own the investor relationship and the operating rhythm that makes it productive, while account teams own customer sales engagements.

- Build and execute a VC and PE ecosystem strategy. Prioritize firms by portfolio fit, sector, stage and opportunity; set partner plans and clear measures of progress.

- Build a VC founder motion with investment and platform teams: qualified introductions, startup program enrollment and founder education from pre-seed through growth (series B).

- Build a PE portfolio motion with operating and value creation teams. Identify shared priorities, connect companies with account teams and run executive briefings and portfolio reviews.

- Create investor briefings, founder and operator workshops, portfolio playbooks and events. Measure conversion and scale the programs that work.

- Own investor relationships through activation with clear mutual value, executive sponsors, referral paths, enablement and regular business reviews.

- Represent Databricks with credibility in investor, founder and executive forums, and bring market and portfolio feedback into our go-to-market strategy.

- Be customer-focused by delivering technical and business results using the Databricks Platform

What we look for:

- You have previously worked in an early-stage company, and you know how to navigate and be successful in a fast-growing organisation

- Min 5+ years of sales experience in SaaS/PaaS or big data companies

- Prior customer relationships with CIOs and important decision-makers

- Simply articulate intricate cloud technologies and big data

postings.description:
GAQ427R213

This Manager role within Databricks’ Credit & Collections organisation is responsible for driving credit strategy, strategic customer collections, AR performance, and complex escalations across a high-growth, usage-based Data/AI business. The role combines financial and commercial judgment with hands-on customer engagement, functional oversight of collection operations, and governance of the outsourced collections model. This is a high-impact opportunity for a CA, CPA, or experienced finance professional to take ownership of credit risk, cash, strategic customer relationships, and AR performance at Databricks scale. This is an individual contributor position with an expectation to be hands-on. 

The impact you will have: 

- Lead the Credit & Collections function for an assigned scope within Databricks, including credit policies, collection practices, risk mitigation, and escalation protocols

- Own credit assessment, risk reviews, credit limits, payment terms, credit holds/releases, and exception management within the established approval framework

- Make credit recommendations and decisions within delegated authority, balancing credit risk, cash conversion, and commercial considerations

- Personally manage collections strategy and executive-level escalations for strategic and high-value Databricks customers

postings.title: Data+AI Workforce Transformation Practitioner — Customer Delivery
postings.description:
CSQ327R12

Enterprise customers are investing in AI, but most are stuck between a successful pilot and real organizational adoption. The gap is not technology. It is whether the workforce can change how it works.

You will own end-to-end workforce transformation engagements with Databricks' largest customers. You will diagnose where a customer's workforce is today, define what needs to change, build the transformation plan, and drive execution until adoption sticks. You are the directly responsible individual for each engagement, not a contributor to someone else's project.

The Impact You Will Have

- Own the full transformation lifecycle for each customer, from workforce assessment through capability pathways, operating rhythm, and measurement. You build the plan and you execute it.

- Run 2 to 3 concurrent engagements across different formats. These range from short-cycle assessments (2 to 4 weeks) to coached transformations (8 to 12 weeks) to deep embedded engagements (12 to 16 weeks). You will manage a mixed portfolio simultaneously.

- Design for multiple organizational layers within a single engagement. That means building executive sponsorship with CDOs, CIOs, and CHROs while also architecting the manager enablement and individual contributor adoption layers underneath.

- Drive execution, not just planning. You will stand up the operating rhythm, coach internal champions, unblock adoption barriers, and adjust the plan when reality diverges from the model.

- Design the human-agent collaboration model for each customer's workforce. Assess workflows and distinguish what should stay human from what should be automated, agent-assisted, or fully agent-led. Design differentiated pathways for builders in technical roles and users in workflow roles.

- Shape how engagements are scoped and priced. You are closest to the work and will ensure that commercial commitments are deliverable.

- Turn what you learn into repeatable tools and playbooks that can scale beyond practitioner-led delivery.

- Partner with technical deployment, AI transformation, and account teams. Other teams build and land the solution. You own what happens after.

What We Look For

- 8 or more years leading workforce or organizational transformation in a technology adoption context. You have executed transformations and owned outcomes, not just designed programs.

- You have led conversations with C-suite or VP-level sponsors and influenced how organizations adopt technology at scale.

- You have done the work, not just designed a curriculum about it. The strongest backgrounds include customer-side data or engineering leaders who drove transformation, former solutions architects or engineers who moved into transformation roles, and consultants with hands-on delivery experience.

- You can assess a workflow, identify what needs to change, and design the capability pathway to get there.

- You understand change management, including sponsorship models, adoption curves, resistance patterns, and how to build internal champions.

- You are comfortable with ambiguity. You will be building the playbook as you go, not executing a mature one.

- You are comfortable with commercial conversations, including engagement scoping, pricing input, and ensuring delivery commitments are realistic.

- Familiarity with data and AI platforms and the enterprise adoption challenges they create.

- A background in professional services, management consulting, or customer success is a plus.

- Experience measuring behavior change tied to business value, not just completions or satisfaction scores, is a plus.

postings.description:
FEQ427R334

At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilizing the the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey. You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform in your customers. You will also help ensure customer success by increasing focus and technical accountability to our most complex customers who need guidance to accelerate usage on Databricks workloads that they have already selected, helping them maximise the value they get of our platform and the return on investment.

This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestration of other focused/specialized teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon. This is in parallel to being technical, with expectations being that you become the post-sale technical lead across all Databricks products. This requires you to use your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate at all levels with an organisation. You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization. 

The impact you will have:

- Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritised customers

- Lead the post-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts

- Be the accountable technical leader assigned to specific use cases and customer(s) across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, success, go-live and healthy consumption of the workloads where the customer has made the decision to consume Databricks

- Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon use cases within an account, oftentimes services multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations

- Leverage both Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services and Support resources, along with escalating to expert level technical experts to build the right tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise

- Create, own and execute a point-of-view as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals

- Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for new product Innovations, private previews and upgrade needs

- Develop an execution plan that covers all activities of all customer-facing technical roles and teams to cover the below work streams:

- Main use cases moving from ‘win’ to production

- Enablement / user growth plan

- Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks’ Lakehouse vision)

- Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning & optimization)

- Executive and operational governance

- Provide internal and external updates - KPI reporting on the status of usage and customer health, covering investment status, important risks, product adoption and use case progression - to your Technical GM

- Programming experience in Python, SQL or Scala 

- Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role

- Understanding of solution architecture related distributed data systems

- Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverables

- Technical program, or project management including account, stakeholder and resource management accountability

- Experience resolving complex and important escalation with senior customer executives

- Experience conducting open-ended discovery workshops, creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis and managing delivery of complex programmes/projects

- Track record of overachievement against quota, Goals or similar objective targets

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience

postings.title: Deployment Strategist
postings.description:
About the Team

The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes, not just a platform.

You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

Role Description

As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.

The impact you will have

- C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.

- End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.

- Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.

- Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.

- Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for

- Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.

- Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.

- Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.

- Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.

- Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

postings.description:
GAQ427R228

While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered.

Databricks Federal supports DOW, IC, federal civilian, and state and local customers. We’re expanding our work across cleared and non-cleared programs and using automation and AI so our security operations scale with the business. 

As Deputy FSO, you'll partner closely with the Industrial Security Lead on the administration of our security programs including personnel and contract security, security education, and government reporting. You'll also work with teammates across Corporate Operations to build the automated workflows and AI assisted processes that help a small team support a growing workforce. 

The impact you will have: 

Administer the Industrial Security and CJIS Programs

- Program support: Help the Industrial Security Lead administer the program under 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM), including routine contact with DCSA and customer government program security officers. 

- Clearance lifecycle: Manage collateral clearances and SCI accesses 

- Compliance and reporting: Manage mandatory reporting across our personnel security programs, and keep our SPP audit ready.

- Contract security: Manage DD254s and subdd254 flowdowns, partnering with Legal, Field Engineering, and Sales.

Automate and Scale

- Automation: Partner with the Industrial Security Lead and Corporate Operations teammates to identify repeatable work across clearance tracking, onboarding and offboarding, training compliance, and contract security, and build automated and AI assisted workflows to handle it.

- Data and intake: Manage the security intake queue and its SLAs, and keep DISS, NISS, SWFT, and internal systems sync and audit ready.

- Security Education: Develop on demand security awareness training and briefings.

- Documentation and metrics: Write SOPs and playbooks, and report program metrics to Databricks Federal leadership.

Grow the Program

- SCIF: Work with the Industrial Security Lead cross functionally to plan, accredit, and operate the future SCIF.

- Civil, state, and local customers: Own our CJIS personnel security program under the FBI CJIS Security Policy and support customer security reviews.

How you’ll work:

We value how you learn and solve problems as much as what you’ve done

- Collaborative: You share context openly and grow your scope alongside the team.

- Empathetic and discreet: You handle sensitive matters with care and sound judgement.

- Process minded: You simplify and automate outcomes, using AI and workflow tools.

- Self directed: You take ownership and stay steady in ambiguity.

What we look for:

- Clearance: An active U.S. government security clearance (Secret minimum, Top Secret preferred) and eligibility for SCI.

- Industrial security foundation: 5+ years in industrial or personnel security at a cleared contractor, government security office, or in the military, with hands-on NISPOM, DCSA, and DD254 experience. 5+ years in industrial or personnel security at a cleared contractor, government security office, or in the military

- System fluency: Working experience with DISS-JVS, NISS, SWFT, and NBIS eApp.

postings.title: Director, Delivery Solutions Architects - Public Sector
postings.description:
CSQ427R326

Please note: Due to federal contract requirements and client-site access obligations, U.S. citizenship is required.

Candidates must reside in Washington, D.C., Maryland, or Virginia

As Director of Delivery Solution Architects (DSA), Public Sector, you will lead a high-impact post-sales technical organization that helps government customers realize value from the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. Your mission is to ensure that complex Data and AI initiatives—across federal civilian, defense, intelligence, state and local government, education, and public-sector-adjacent organizations—move from concept to production as quickly, securely, and effectively as possible.

You will lead DSA managers and a growing team of Delivery Solution Architects responsible for technical strategy, customer outcomes, platform adoption, and usage growth across the Public Sector. You will bridge technical strategy and durable customer value, ensuring teams guide customers through architecture decisions, implementation planning, and scalable operating models for data, analytics, AI, and agentic applications.

You will make investment and coverage decisions in collaboration with regional Sales and Field Engineering leaders, shape the value proposition of the DSA function for Public Sector, and build an organization that delivers predictable customer outcomes in a complex, high-growth environment.

The Impact You Will Have:

- Build and lead: Recruit, coach, and scale a diverse, high-performing team of DSAs and managers. Foster a culture of psychological safety, collaboration, and customer obsession.

- 

Define, operationalize, and continuously improve the post-sales execution strategy for Databricks’ Public Sector business. 

- 

Partner with Sales, Solutions Architecture, Professional Services, Customer Success, and strategic partners to align account plans, technical success plans, resource investments, and growth strategies. 

- 

Establish scalable account assignments, customer coverage, prioritization, capacity planning, and resource-allocation practices for strategic Public Sector accounts. 

- 

Standardize how DSAs guide customers from use-case discovery and architecture through implementation, production go-live, adoption, and platform expansion. 

- 

Lead a technically excellent DSA organization with deep expertise in cloud data platforms, data engineering, warehousing, ETL/ELT, streaming, governance, machine learning, generative AI, and agentic applications. 

- 

Ensure customers receive practical, secure, scalable architectural guidance for production data products, analytics platforms, AI applications, and mission-critical workloads. 

- 

Apply Public Sector-specific requirements—including security, compliance, governance, mission continuity, procurement, and complex stakeholder environments—to architecture and delivery decisions. 

- 

Serve as a trusted executive technical advisor for select strategic customers, linking technical roadmaps and modernization programs to agency missions and measurable outcomes. 

- 

Build strong executive and operational relationships across customer technical, program, procurement, operational, and leadership stakeholders to accelerate adoption and long-term value. 

- 

Create operating mechanisms, playbooks, metrics, and review cadences to monitor customer health, delivery progress, adoption, usage growth, risks, escalations, and forecasted expansion. 

- 

Drive cross-functional resolution of delivery blockers and escalations, while providing leadership feedback on field processes, product needs, programs, and organizational investments.

What We Look For:

- 7+ years of customer-facing experience in technical delivery, architecture, consulting, customer success, professional services, or post-sales leadership roles. 

- 5+ years of people-leadership experience, proven ability to recruit, coach, develop, and build career paths for high-performing technical talent, including success leading managers and scaling multi-level technical organizations.

- Experience building and leading post-sales, delivery, customer success, architecture, consulting, or professional-services organizations. 

- Deep expertise in cloud data and AI technologies, including data engineering, data warehousing, analytics, ETL/ELT, data governance, machine learning, data science, and AI. 

- Demonstrated success delivering production-grade data products, analytics platforms, AI solutions, and other scalable, secure, and governable customer workloads. 

- Ability to lead teams through architecture decisions, technical success planning, delivery execution, production go-lives, and customer-growth strategies. 

- Deep understanding of Public Sector and regulated customer environments, including mission priorities, complex stakeholder models, governance requirements, and long planning cycles. 

- Executive presence and business acumen to engage senior leaders, manage strategic accounts, and make portfolio-level resource, investment, coverage, and prioritization decisions. 

- Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills, with a track record of partnering across Sales, pre-sales, Professional Services, Customer Success, Engineering, Product, Marketing, and external partners to resolve escalations, mitigate risk, remove blockers, and improve customer outcomes.

Additional Requirements:

- U.S. citizenship is required due to Public Sector client-support requirements.

- Willingness to travel up to 30%, primarily within the Washington, D.C. metro area and to customer locations as needed.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

postings.title: Director of Engineering - Databricks Commercialization & Marketplace
postings.description:
Director of Engineering - Databricks Commercialization & Marketplace 

P-1630

About the role

Every product Databricks ships has to be priced, contracted, rated and billed before it can earn a dollar. The Money organization builds the systems that make this happen, at hyperscaler scale and across every major cloud. We built the world's only cross-cloud integrated rating engine in-house, and it now rates billions of dollars in revenue. Our next goal is bigger: a fully automated, zero-touch order-to-cash flow where the platform is the source of truth for accounts, contracts and subscriptions, and Month End Close needs little or no human intervention.

As Director of Engineering, you will lead the engineering organization that owns this commercial engine from start to finish. You will set the product and technology strategy for how Databricks makes money. You will be the engineering voice Finance, Product and GTM leaders turn to for strategic decisions. You will also build the leadership bench that lets the organization keep scaling.

Speed is critical. Databricks keeps inventing new ways to sell: commit and pay-as-you-go, marketplaces, conditional benefits, strategic partnerships and new clouds and regions. The commerce engine either makes each of these fast and safe to launch, or it becomes the bottleneck. You will make sure it is the former.

What you'll own

The org covers six commercial domains:

- Pricing configuration: SKUs, multipliers, price-change processes, deal desk and discounting

- Orders and contracts: from negotiated quote to order to signed customer contract

- Subscriptions: commit, pay-as-you-go and proof-of-concept subscriptions, plus how contracts are tied to payment methods

- Rating: applying each customer's negotiated price, discounts and conditional benefits to ingested usage to compute the bill

- Billing: commit drawdown, invoicing, Month End Close and related financial processes

- Marketplace: third-party data and solutions, available seamlessly to Databricks customers

The impact you'll have

- Set and communicate the vision. Write the multi-year product and technology strategy for the commerce engine, toward a zero-touch order-to-cash flow and a next-generation billing architecture. Present it clearly to executives, Finance and Product leaders, so that strategy and architecture decisions come to you by default.

- Own business outcomes across orgs, not just your team's part. Revenue-critical programs routinely span 100+ people across Finance, Product, IT, Accounts and GTM. You will own the full outcome: dependency plans with clear owners, timelines, quality bars and escalation triggers, raised early in leadership forums so cross-org risks don't become executive surprises.

- Make commercialization a platform capability. Build reusable building blocks (credits, commits, conditional benefits, marketplace and partner billing) so that new pricing models and routes to market ship in weeks, not quarters.

- Treat foundations as seriously as features. Hold reliability, correctness, SOX and compliance readiness, security, cost visibility and operational load to the same standard as product launches. Billing errors should be structurally impossible, operational work should grow more slowly than revenue, and postmortems should actually lead to change.

- Partner deeply with Business & Finance. Turn accounting, close and compliance requirements into engineering design. Keep improving the Month End Close timeline and audit readiness, and earn the trust of Technical Accounting, Revenue Ops and Strategy & Execution leaders.

- Build a team of leaders. Grow the organization from one with a large group of direct-report engineers to one led by strong engineering managers and tech-lead managers, with clear subteams, domain boundaries and named owners. Coach managers to be great people leaders, give specific feedback and career plans, and recognize high-performing teams publicly.

- Hire like a founder. Act as the hiring owner for the Money Bellevue site. Source and close senior engineering and management talent, put the company first when placing hires across Money teams, and help raise the Databricks engineering hiring bar.

What we're looking for

- 12+ years in software engineering, including 6+ years leading engineering organizations and managing managers, ideally in billing, payments, commerce, fintech or other systems where errors directly cost revenue or create regulatory exposure

- A track record of delivering large, revenue-critical, cross-functional programs (for example, replacing a billing or rating system, migrating a source of truth, or automating order-to-cash) on time and with high quality

- Technical depth in distributed systems and large-scale data pipelines. You can discuss correctness, idempotency, reconciliation and data lineage with tech leads, and you know when to coach and when to decide.

- Fluency in order-to-cash and finance concepts: pricing and discounting, contracts, revenue recognition, invoicing, month-end close, SOX controls. You have earned trust as a partner to Finance and Accounting leaders.

- Strong product judgment: you can spot gaps in the commercial platform, shape requirements with Product, and make build-versus-buy decisions that pay off over time

- Clear, confident communication of strategy to executives, plus the ability to influence peers in Product, Finance, IT and GTM without direct authority

- Experience scaling an organization quickly while keeping a high hiring bar, developing strong leaders and engineers, and keeping them engaged on internal platform work

- BS in Computer Science or a related field; MS preferred. Experience with Kafka, Apache Spark, Delta Lake or cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus.

Why this role

You will run the engine behind the revenue of one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world. The problems involve hard distributed-systems correctness at scale, high financial and compliance stakes, and a direct, visible link to company growth. You'll lead an established, high-trust team with a strong delivery record and help shape what the next generation of the commerce engine looks like.

postings.description:
(P-1490)

Databricks processes petabytes of data and billions of transaction events daily - every cluster launch, every query executed, every dollar billed flows through infrastructure that must never fail. When we process billions in billing transactions with 99.999% accuracy requirements, when we ingest terabytes per second across 100+ regions, when a five-minute outage costs millions in revenue and customer trust - infrastructure isn't just important, it's existential. The next phase of our growth demands disaster recovery systems that prove reliability rather than hope for it, testing frameworks that catch production-scale problems before deployment, correctness guarantees that make billing errors structurally impossible, and automation that scales operations sublinearly with growth.

In this leadership opportunity, you will build the data infrastructure organization that makes Databricks' continued growth possible. You'll establish foundational teams in Bengaluru owning the bedrock systems that guarantee billing correctness, operational resilience, and zero-downtime recovery across our entire monetization stack, alongside multi-region data ingestion, developer platforms, and deployment automation that eliminate friction at petabyte scale. This isn't about maintaining what exists; it's about architecting the infrastructure that enables Databricks to scale while reducing operational burden. You'll define what world-class infrastructure looks like for the next decade of data platforms.

You will pursue these challenges as a founding technical leader in our fastest-growing engineering hub and strategic partner to global infrastructure leaders. In addition to building world-class teams, you will shape architectural decisions that ripple across the company and champion infrastructure-as-product thinking that transforms infrastructure into force multipliers globally. You'll work in an engineering culture born from Apache Spark and open source, where technical depth matters and infrastructure engineers are celebrated as craftspeople.

The perfect candidate has built infrastructure organizations at companies where five nines weren't simply aspirational, where petabyte-scale wasn't marketing but Monday, and where the infrastructure team's technical leverage determined whether the business could scale or stall. You have the technical depth to debate data architecture, the strategic vision to define multi-year platform roadmaps, the leadership craft to build teams that top engineers want to join, and most importantly, the conviction that data infrastructure done right doesn't just support the business; it defines what's possible.

The impact you’ll have:

- Deliver the infrastructure vision for systems processing billions in daily billing transactions with zero tolerance for error, building disaster recovery that's provably reliable, testing frameworks that catch what production sees, correctness systems that make billing errors structurally impossible, and observability that predicts failures before they happen

- Build Bengaluru's data infrastructure organization by establishing it as the destination for India's top infrastructure talent, hiring multiple engineering managers who become force multipliers, and creating a culture where solving hard distributed systems problems at scale is the daily work

- Own business-critical systems operating 24/7/365 across 100+ regions where even 99.9% uptime means hours of customer pain, driving reliability improvements that prevent millions in revenue loss while eliminating operational toil through frameworks that make systems self-healing, self-tuning, and self-documenting

- Ship platforms that compound engineering leverage across Databricks: correctness frameworks that catch billing errors before customers do, deployment automation that makes regional expansion push-button, data integration systems that process petabyte-scale flows without human intervention, and testing infrastructure where comprehensive coverage is automatic, not heroic

- Position infrastructure as product by treating internal engineering teams as customers with SLAs, measuring adoption and satisfaction, iterating based on feedback, and demonstrating that every dollar invested in infrastructure returns multiplicative gains in product velocity, reliability improvements, or cost reductions

What you’ll need:

- 14+ years in distributed systems engineering with 6+ years leading infrastructure organizations and 4+ years managing managers at companies where infrastructure failures meant immediate revenue impact, customer escalations, or regulatory consequences - and you built the systems and teams that made those failures rare

- Technical depth across petabyte-scale data pipelines and distributed systems reliability where you can engage from "how should we architect multi-region disaster recovery" to "why is this Kafka cluster exhibiting this latency pattern" while knowing when to coach versus when to decide

- Track record defining multi-year infrastructure vision and translating it into sequential deliverables that show value quarterly while building toward architectural end states, positioning infrastructure investments as business enablers rather than cost centers, and making build-vs-buy decisions that compound over time

- Experience building 99.999%+ reliable systems with established practices for SLOs/SLIs, chaos engineering, disaster recovery, and sophisticated observability that predicts failures before they happen

- Proven ability to scale infrastructure organizations in high-growth environments where you've doubled engineering while maintaining quality bar, developed engineering managers, and created teams where retention is high because the problems are interesting and the culture is strong

- Communication skills to make complex infrastructure decisions legible to executives (translating technical investments into business outcomes), influence cross-functional partners without authority, build trust across global teams in different timezones with different working styles, and represent Databricks' technical brand externally

- BS in Computer Science or Engineering; MS or Ph.D. preferred. Experience with Apache Spark, Delta Lake, large-scale data infrastructure, fintech/billing systems, or leading infrastructure through hypergrowth strongly preferred
