Reporting to a TSE manager - you will be part of a world class global support engineering organization for Databricks, known for your technical depth and delivering impeccable customer service.

The Impact You Will Have

- Act as senior technical solution expert for complex issues spanning data pipelines, ML pipelines and/or AI applications, applying deep expertise in distributed systems. 

- Analyse and troubleshoot production workloads at the code level, optimise for performance, reliability, latency, and cost.

- Diagnose and support Machine Learning and/or Large Language Model deployments, including real-time and batch inference, autoscaling, monitoring, logging, and alerting. Serve as a Subject Matter Expert guiding customers on experiment tracking, model registry, versioning, evaluation, labelling, tracing, and lifecycle observability.

- Provide high-quality support by guiding customers in leveraging Databricks AI to solve generative AI use cases & challenges, leveraging LLMs, MCP, AI Agents, RAG/Agentic RAG, APIs, vector embeddings, semantic search, Vector Search/Lakebase databases, context orchestration, memory management, and prompt engineering.

- Collaborate with internal teams to influence roadmap, product improvements and support business growth.

8+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling Data, Machine Learning, and AI systems on-premises and in the cloud using Python, Scala, and Java in production environments, with expertise in Machine Learning and/or generative AI. Proficient in data engineering necessary for orchestrating end-to-end machine learning training pipelines, ideally with experience processing large datasets with Apache Spark.

postings.title: Senior Payroll Accountant
postings.description:
GAQ327R161

About the Role

We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve — leveraging AI, automation, and modern tooling to operate at the pace Databricks demands. The Senior Payroll Accountant plays a critical role in executing the day-to-day and month-end accounting tasks associated with Databricks' global payroll. As part of the Global Accounting organization and reporting directly to the Payroll Accounting Manager based in India, you will tackle complex reconciliations, execute detailed variance analysis, and drive process improvements. The ideal candidate is a highly analytical self-starter with a keen eye for detail who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

The impact you will have:

- Prepare and record comprehensive payroll journal entries, including salaries, bonuses, commissions, stock-based compensation, benefits, and multi-state/international taxes.

- Prepare accurate monthly balance sheet reconciliations for assigned accounts, proactively identifying and resolving any variances or discrepancies within the close period.

- Perform monthly payroll flux analysis, identifying and investigating drivers behind significant period-over-period movements.

- Prepare payroll accounting for equity compensation programs such as RSUs, stock options, and ESPP, ensuring accurate recording, tax withholding treatment, and reconciliation between equity, payroll, and the general ledger.

- Execute payroll accounting across global entities, with exposure to high-complexity jurisdictions, including Netherlands, Brazil, France, Germany, and India, ensuring accurate accounting treatment and local compliance.

- Partner closely with the Payroll Operations team to research and resolve discrepancies between the payroll register and the general ledger.

- Support annual local statutory audits, consolidated external audits, and internal SOX requests; help maintain a documented system of accounting policies and procedures (SOPs).

- Partner with the Manager and cross-functional teams (Legal, External Advisors) to set up accounting processes and systems for new international subsidiaries and locations.

- Lead testing and implementation of updates to cloud-based payroll and accounting systems; perform ad hoc financial analysis and drive process improvement projects to increase efficiency.

- Support AI and automation initiatives across payroll accounting, including reconciliation tooling, variance detection, and process improvements that reduce manual work.

What we look for:

- BA, BS Degree with a focus in Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or Finance

- 6-8 years of general accounting experience, with a minimum of 4+ years dedicated specifically to payroll accounting

- Chartered Accountant (CA) or CPA equivalent certification is strongly preferred. 

- Experience with equity compensation accounting (RSUs, stock options, ESPP) is a plus

- Experience supporting annual statutory audits and the partnership skills necessary to collaborate effectively with local and remote teams across various time zones

- Exposure to global payroll jurisdictions, particularly high-complexity countries such as Netherlands, Brazil, France, Germany, and India, is a plus

- Hands-on experience with cloud-based accounting systems and a strong working knowledge of US GAAP

- Hands-on experience or strong interest in driving automation and AI adoption in payroll or accounting operations

- Proven experience partnering with local accounting teams to file statutory accounts and the flexibility to support remote teams across different geographic areas, including with US-based accounting teams

(GAQ128R87)

The Senior Sales Compensation Manager (L7) is the senior systems expert for Databricks' commissions platform. You will co-own how commissions get calculated: how the Xactly Incent plans are built, and the data integrations and pipelines that feed every calculation. You'll be the trusted co-owner of the system design, the technical roadmap, and the systems controls in a fast-growing, consumption-based SaaS business. You’ll take on ambiguous, cross-functional problems that span several systems. You'll influence senior leaders in Finance, GTM, and Engineering, and raise the bar for the team through documentation, enablement, and AI-first automation.

The impact you will have

Plan configuration and calculation engine

- Co-lead annual (and mid-year if applicable) plan builds in Xactly for every major plan family, including AE, sales leaders, xDR, field engineering, and partner plans. This covers rule logic, rate tables, accelerators, quotas, crediting hierarchies, and tuning the calculation engine.

- Partner with Plan Design to turn plan design decks into system specifications. Configure, run UAT on, and test new plans before they go to production. Co-own the system implementation timeline and the go-live schedule for the new fiscal year.

- Be the responder when calculations break, data sync fails, or configuration has defects.

Integrations, data pipelines and system design

- Co-own the integration layer between Salesforce and Xactly and the data loads from the Databricks lakehouse into Xactly. This covers object mappings, the API integration user, OAuth and IP restriction upkeep, and the schedules and dependencies of the pipelines that feed plan crediting.

- Collaborate and influence the future-state design and technical roadmap for the commissions platform. That includes evaluating the commission engine strategy and moving manual files onto governed pipelines with change management and SOX-aligned logging.

- Collaborate and influence vendor escalations and support cases, and lead day-to-day work with the Xactly account team.

Controls, close, and audit

- Co-own the commissions systems SOX controls: plan configuration and change management, system-to-system validation, plan reconciliation, quarterly user access reviews. Act as a subject-matter expert in walkthroughs with external auditors.

- Run the systems side of the monthly and quarterly close calendar with high precision.

- Make change requests to the change-approval board (CAB) audit-ready from the start, with full descriptions, approvals, and test evidence.

AI, automation and insight

- Collaborate and influence AI adoption. Use it to turn plan design into configuration, automatically generate documentation, and validate data with AI agents. Use AI-driven anomaly detection to find payout discrepancies before they reach payroll.

- Use predictive modeling to estimate commissions impact of proposed plan changes/adjustments or for accrual purposes.

- Turn prototypes into tools the team actually uses, and track the time saved and quality gained.

Cross-functional influence

- Represent Commissions Systems to Engineering, IT, Finance Data & Strategy, GTM Strategy & Ops, Accounting, FP&A, and Partner teams. Turn business requirements into engineering terms and the other way around, and agree on SLAs and intake processes.

- Be the voice telling downstream teams about system changes that affect their reporting and analysis.

Leadership & culture

- Help make the team resilient by design. Turn undocumented rules and configuration knowledge into playbooks, wikis, and recorded walkthroughs so no one person is a single point of failure.

- Mentor and cross-train other team members, including offshore resources. Help build a culture of continuous learning and AI adoption.

- Turn concerns into recommendations with clear trade-offs that win senior leaders' support. 

What we look for

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field.

- 12+ years in sales compensation, commissions systems, or sales/finance operations, including deep hands-on administration and configuration of an SPM platform.

- Expert skills in Xactly Incent and Connect. Experience with other SPM tools is a plus.

- Strong grasp of Salesforce data models and integrations, and of data pipeline concepts. SQL or lakehouse experience (e.g., Databricks) is strongly preferred.

- A track record of running SOX controls and ITGCs, and of leading audit walkthroughs.

- Fluency in SaaS go-to-market comp models: quotas, OTI, accelerators, overlays, SPIFFs, MBOs, and consumption-based crediting.

postings.description:
GAQ126R44

About Databricks

At Databricks, our mission is to help data teams solve the world's toughest problems—and that begins with empowering our own employees with exceptional internal products. The Databricks IT organization is a product-led engineering team building intelligent, AI-powered platforms that simplify how work gets done across the company. For Finance, our vision is to eliminate manual, repetitive work by automating complex business processes, surfacing actionable insights, and orchestrating end-to-end workflows. We are reimagining finance operations so teams spend less time processing transactions, chasing approvals, and resolving exceptions, and more time delivering strategic insights that accelerate the business.

We're looking for a SAP Developer to build the applications, extensions, and integrations that bring this vision to life. In this role, you'll write clean-core extensions on SAP BTP, build full-stack apps and Fiori experiences, wire up integrations between SAP and the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, and help embed AI and agentic capabilities directly into finance workflows. You'll work at the intersection of SAP and AI—shipping software that makes finance operations faster, smarter, and more automated.

The Opportunity

SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks' core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash. As an SAP Developer, you'll be hands-on-keyboard building the layer that makes those processes intelligent: side-by-side extensions on BTP, event-driven integrations into the Lakehouse, and AI-assisted workflows that automate routine work and guide users through exceptions and approvals. You'll build with modern SAP and Databricks AI tooling—combining SAP’s core ERP capabilities with Databricks-native AI, agentic applications, and automation—while keeping the SAP digital core clean, scalable, and upgradable. Your mission is to turn designs into robust, production-grade software that combines the strength of SAP with the power of Databricks AI.

What You'll Do

- Build Clean-Core Extensions: Develop in-app and side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP that keep the S/4HANA digital core clean and upgrade-ready, using released APIs and extension points rather than core modifications.

- Develop Databricks-Native Applications: Build scalable, full-stack applications and services on the Databricks platform that extend and integrate with SAP, leveraging Databricks-native capabilities, APIs, data services, and AI/agentic tooling to deliver modern Finance experiences while keeping the SAP core clean.

- Build Integrations: Implement secure, resilient integrations across SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP Integration Suite, event-driven patterns, APIs, OData v4, and change-data feeds into the Databricks Lakehouse, with solid error handling and monitoring.

- Embed AI & Agentic Capabilities: Build AI-powered and agentic capabilities into Finance workflows using Databricks AI, integrating seamlessly with SAP and other enterprise systems. Apply RAG, prompt engineering, tool calling, and human-in-the-loop controls to automate processes safely while maintaining governance and auditability

- Move SAP Data to the Lakehouse: Partner with data engineering to build the pipelines and extraction patterns (CDC, OData, APIs) that land SAP data in Databricks cleanly, with attention to modeling, lineage, and data quality.

- Engineer for Quality: Write unit and integration tests, work within CI/CD and transport pipelines for ABAP and BTP artifacts, participate in code reviews, and follow the team's security and coding standards.

- Collaborate: Work closely with the technical lead, functional experts, and product owners to turn requirements and designs into working software, and iterate quickly based on user feedback.

What You Bring

- 6+ years of SAP development experience, with hands-on delivery of at least one end-to-end SAP solution (an S/4HANA extension, a CAP or RAP app on BTP with Fiori, or an Integration Suite flow) in production.

- Modern ABAP: Strong command of ABAP Cloud, ABAP CDS, and the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP), plus OData (v2/v4).

- SAP BTP: Working-to-advanced experience with BTP runtimes, core services (Connectivity, Destination, XSUAA/auth), and deploying, securing, and operating apps on the platform.

- Front End: Solid experience with SAP Fiori concepts, SAPUI5, and Fiori Elements (OData v4).

- Integration: Experience with SAP Integration Suite / API Management and event-driven patterns (OData/REST, IDoc, Cloud Integration, Event Mesh) across hybrid landscapes.

- AI Fluency: Strong understanding of SAP and Databricks AI capabilities, with practical knowledge of generative AI and agentic concepts—including RAG, prompt engineering, grounding, tool calling, and enterprise AI governance. Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications and workflows on Databricks and integrating them with SAP is a strong plus.

- Engineering Practice: Comfort with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern dev tooling (VS Code, ABAP Development Tools in Eclipse, MTA/CF packaging).

- Clean-Core Mindset: Understanding of clean-core principles and why extensions belong side-by-side or in-app rather than in the digital core.

- Collaboration: Clear communicator who can work across functional, product, and engineering teams and take ownership of what they ship.

Preferred Qualifications

- Domain knowledge in finance, procurement, or supply chain that speeds delivery and requirements understanding.

- Experience extending or customizing Joule agents via SAP Build / Joule Studio, or building agents on SAP AI Foundation.

- Experience building applications on modern data platforms (such as Databricks) that extend or sit alongside SAP.

- Cloud-native experience—containerization and Kubernetes (Kyma), observability, and scalability patterns.

- SAP certification in ABAP, SAP BTP, or SAP Build, and prior work in a high-growth technology company.

postings.description:
P-97

Our mission at Databricks is to radically simplify the whole data lifecycle from ingestion to ETL, BI, and all the way up to ML/AI with a unified platform. To achieve this goal, we believe the data warehouse architecture as we know it today will be replaced by a new architectural pattern, Lakehouse (CIDR 2021 paper), open platforms that unify data warehousing and advanced analytics. The new architecture will help address several major challenges, including data staleness, reliability, total cost of ownership, data lock-in, and limited use-case support.

A critical part of realizing this vision is the next generation (decoupled) query engine and structured storage system that can outperform specialized data warehouses in relational query performance, yet retain the expressiveness and of general purpose systems such as Spark™ to support diverse workloads ranging from ETL to data science.

As part of this team, you will be working in one or more of the following areas to design and implement these next gen systems that leapfrog state-of-the-art:

- Query compilation and optimization

- Distributed query execution and scheduling

- Vectorized execution engine

- Data security

- Resource management

- Transaction coordination

- Efficient storage structures (encodings, indexes)

- Automatic physical data optimization

What we look for:

- A passion for database systems, storage systems, distributed systems, language design, or performance optimization

- Experience working towards a multi-year vision with incremental deliverables

- Motivated by delivering customer value and impact

- 5+ years of experience working in a related system (preferred)

Apache Spark™: Develop the de facto open source standard framework for big data.

Data Plane Storage: Provide reliable and high performance services and client libraries for storing and accessing humongous amount of data on cloud storage backends, e.g., AWS S3, Azure Blob Store.

postings.title: Senior Solutions Architect (EDW Enterprise Data Warehouse Migrations)
postings.description:
At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems. Our customers leverage the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to power their mission critical Data and AI applications to improve how their organisations leverage data and insights to make better decisions, faster. Customers rely on Databricks for the full range of data workloads, including data engineering, ETL, near real-time streaming, machine learning, SQL analytics, and advanced analytics.

The Solutions Architect (EDW Migrations) executes on Databricks’ strategic product lines to develop, establish and drive product adoption and product market fit to grow customer adoption across EMEA. By working with leadership, product and direct account teams, you will jointly engage customers, foster the necessary relationships and position in-depth approaches to migrating their EDW to the Databricks Intelligence Platform. You will develop the appropriate approach, the guardrails, and the steps needed for customers to successfully deliver on their business objectives.

The Solutions Architect (EDW Migrations) is paired with Product Specialists for Data and Governance. Together, you will devise and implement a strategy across key accounts, develop presentations, demos and other assets, and with account teams deliver them such that the field and customers make informed decisions on adoption strategy and its implementation.

The impact you will have

- Lead Regional Migration Strategy: Collaborate with EMEA GTM leadership and account teams to design and drive the technical GTM and adoption strategy for large-scale EDW migrations to the Databricks Intelligence Platform

- Develop Programmatic and Scalable Migration Processes: Architect and continuously refine programmatic assets and detailed technical guides that enable field teams and partners to execute migrations.

- Build and Integrate Assessment Tooling: Help maintain, enhance, and direct the development of automated assessment tools from customer engagements.

- Drive Tier-3 Technical Championship: Act as the ultimate technical escalation point for highly complex, strategic, or stalled migrations in must-win accounts across EMEA.

- Enable and Scale the Regional teams: Scale the presales migration practice by mentoring and coaching the EMEA community of Solutions Architects (SAs) and Specialist SAs (SSAs) to ensure scale.

- Bridge Field Insights and Product R&D: Serve as a primary technical feedback loop to Product Management and Engineering.

- Establish Industry Thought Leadership: Author whitepapers, publish technical blogs, and deliver high-impact presentations at public forums (such as the Data + AI Summit) to position the Databricks Intelligence Platform as the premier platform for enterprise database modernization.

- Handle the most complex technical challenges in this product line by acting as the tier-3 escalation point for the field, ensuring customer success in mission-critical environments.

Competencies & Responsibilities

- 8+ Years of Customer-Facing Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, architect, or consulting role influencing technical executives (CIOs, CISOs, DBAs, and Platform Leads) and driving high-level database modernization strategy.

- Legacy Data Warehouse & Modernization Architecture understanding of legacy EDW systems (any of Teradata, Netezza, Snowflake, Synapse, Redshift, and Exadata) and architectures required to successfully transition workloads to the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.

- Mastery of migration migrations scope & progression taking customers from EDW to the full capabilities of the Data Intelligence Platform.

- Demonstrated competence in the Lakehouse architecture including hands-on experience with Apache Spark, Python and SQL

- Excellent communication skills; both written and verbal

- Public Cloud Architecting: Hands-on experience designing and implementing big data architectures within major public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

- Strategic Enablement & Community Mentorship

- Experience collaborating with Professional Services and Global Systems Integrators to standardize migration delivery methodologies and ensure smooth handoffs.

Vertical Sector - Any Sector - Growth accounts x 2 new roles

As a Sr. Solutions Architect, you are an expert-level technical leader responsible for the organization's most complex customer engagements. You drive consumption strategy, own executive-level relationships, and serve as the definitive technical authority for your accounts. You have declared your archetype—a recognised technical specialisation that makes you a force multiplier across your team and region. You operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise, strategic account planning, and executive influence. 

The Impact You Will Have

- Drive the technical and consumption strategy for the organization's most complex customer engagements, directly influencing platform adoption and revenue growth.

- Own senior-level technical relationships — serving as a trusted advisor on enterprise data and AI strategy

- Lead the most complex architecture engagements: multi-workload platforms, enterprise-wide migrations, real-time systems, and AI/ML at scale

- Operate as an Expert on the Databricks Platform with a declared archetype — actively mentoring others and driving horizontal impact across your team

- Develop and execute competitive strategies for your customers, positioning Databricks against incumbent and emerging platforms

- Orchestrate cross-functional teams (DSAs, SSAs, Partners, Product) to deliver enterprise-grade solutions

- Contribute to Field Engineering thought leadership through customer-facing content, workshops, and community engagement

- 8+ years in solutions architecture, principal engineering, technical pre-sales leadership, or a senior customer-facing technical role

- Expert-level coding proficiency — Python, SQL, and ideally Spark/PySpark. You will complete a live coding assessment and a platform build during the interview

- Deep expertise in enterprise data architecture: distributed systems at scale, streaming/real-time, lakehouse design patterns, data governance frameworks, and cloud-native platforms

- Expert-level Databricks Platform knowledge (or equivalent depth in competing platforms with demonstrated rapid learning ability)

- Declared technical specialisation with recognised depth — e.g., real-time architectures, ML/AI platforms, data governance, large-scale migrations, or industry-specific solutions

- Proven track record of driving consumption growth and platform adoption in large accounts

- Executive presence — ability to influence Directors, VPs, and C-level stakeholders on long-term data and AI strategy

- Experience leading competitive displacements and complex enterprise evaluations

- Strong strategic thinking — connecting technical architecture decisions to business outcomes and revenue impact

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience); advanced degrees are valued

Nice to Have:

- Databricks certifications

- Prior experience at Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Google, Microsoft, or a top-tier data/AI company

- Published thought leadership (blogs, conference talks, open source contributions)

- Industry vertical expertise with executive-level domain credibility

postings.description:
(FEQ327R229)

The Solutions Architect (Lakebase) team executes on Databricks’ strategic Product Operating Model that provides enhanced focus on earlier stage, highly prioritised product lines in order to establish product market fit, and set the course for rapid revenue growth. They are part of a global go-to-market team mandate, though individually will cover a specific, local region. Clients may span across one or more business units and verticals. By working in partnership with direct account teams, they will jointly engage clients, foster the necessary relationships, position in-depth the specific product line, so as to provide compelling reasons for clients to adopt and grow the usage of the given product. They understand the appropriate approach, the guardrails, and the steps needed to successfully adopt the product line, as clients deliver on their business objectives.

The Solutions Architect (Lakebase) is paired with an Account Executive aligned to a given product line with specific targets accordingly. Together, they will devise and implement a strategy across their assigned set of accounts, develop presentations, demos and other assets and deliver them such that clients make an informed decision as they decide to adopt the product-line in a meaningful way.

The Lakebase product-line requires the following core technical competencies:

- 10+ years of transactional database (OLTP) expertise across engineering, product development, administration, and pre-sales, with a proven track record of designing and delivering client-facing solutions.

- Credibility in influencing OLTP products with the market insight needed to shape and prioritise roadmap capabilities.

- Experience architecting solutions that integrate transactional data systems within broader Big Data, Lakehouse, and AI ecosystems.

- Infrastructure, platform and administration expertise around disaster recovery, high availability, backup and recovery, scale-out methods, identity and security management, migrations (vendor-to-vendor, on-prem to cloud)

The impact you will have

- Collaborate with GTM leadership and account teams to design and execute high-impact engagement strategies across your territory.

- As a trusted advisor, serve as an expert Solutions Architect and "champion," building technical credibility with stakeholders to drive product adoption and vision.

- Enable clients at scale through workshops and developing customer-facing collateral that helps increase technical knowledge and thought leadership.

- Influence product roadmap by translating field-derived, data-driven insights into strategic recommendations for Product and Engineering teams

- Handle the most complex technical challenges in this product line by acting as the tier-3 escalation point for the field, ensuring customer success in mission-critical environments.

 Competencies & Responsibilities

- 6+ years in a customer-facing, pre-sales or consulting role influencing technical executives, driving high-level data strategy and product adoption.

- Proven ability to co-plan large territories with Account Executives and operate in a highly coordinated, cross-functional effort across GTM and R&D teams.

- Experience collaborating with Global System Integrators (GSIs) and third-party consulting organisations to drive customer outcomes.

- Proficient in programming, debugging, and problem-solving using SQL and Python. Also requiring prior experience with Apache Spark or similar analytics engine tooling for large-scale data processing. 

- Hands-on experience building solutions within major public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

- Broad experience (in two or more) and understanding across the fields of data engineering, data warehousing, AI, ML, governance, transactional systems, app development, and streaming.

- Undergraduate degree (or higher) in a technical field such as Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or similar.

- A track record of driving complex projects to completion in fast-paced, customer-facing environments.

postings.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, AI Runtime
postings.location: Mountain View, California; San Francisco, California
postings.description:
P-1096

At Databricks, we run the world's largest AI platform. We believe the next breakthroughs will come from models trained on domain-specific enterprise data, not from bigger general-purpose models alone.

That's why we built AI Runtime, a serverless product that makes GPU training of any size feel simple, so companies can train their own models the way frontier labs do. Customers across industries train on it, right next to the enterprise data already in Databricks. Among them are Rivian in automotive, Robinhood in fintech, and Merck, which builds foundation models for drug discovery. Our own AI researchers use it to post-train models with hundreds of billions to nearly a trillion parameters.

It takes a lot of engineering to make that work, and we've written about it on our blog: how we keep GPUs reliable, make training fault-tolerant, and speed up fine-tuning with fused kernels and smart sequence packing. AI agents now launch experiments too, and on our research team they've already increased training jobs 8x.

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you'll work on the systems behind all of this, solving the hardest technical problems and shaping where AI Runtime goes next.

The impact you will have:

- Drive AI Runtime's architecture and lead Databricks' long-term technical direction in AI training infrastructure.

- Define the reliability and observability strategy for a fleet that keeps growing in scale and complexity.

- Shape AI Runtime's developer experience for people and agents, so even the largest training jobs feel as simple as a first experiment.

- Anticipate industry trends and choose the technical bets that prepare AI Runtime for new GPU generations and workload types.

- Take on the hardest multi-node training problems yourself, from orchestration and GPU scheduling to data loading and checkpointing.

- Make training faster and cheaper by raising efficiency across model architectures and GPU accelerators.

- Work with research, product, and customers to decide what we build next and align teams on hard technical calls.

- Champion engineering excellence, raise the bar, and help us hire and grow great engineers.

What we look for:

- 15+ years in large-scale distributed systems, with significant depth in GPU training, high-performance computing, or ML systems.

- Hands-on experience training large models with FSDP, DeepSpeed, or Megatron, and fluency in parallelism strategies.

- Expertise in GPU performance, including accelerator architecture, high-speed interconnects, and kernels.

- Strong understanding of training resilience patterns, such as checkpointing, failure detection, and automatic recovery.

- A background in building and running multi-tenant cloud platforms as products.

- A track record of setting technical direction across teams and seeing it through to business impact.

- The credibility to bring teams to agreement on difficult trade-offs, and a reputation as a mentor senior engineers seek out.

- BS in Computer Science or a related field (MS or PhD preferred).

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

You will join Databricks' engineering organization, working with teams that develop products and features for thousands of enterprises worldwide. Our engineering teams build highly technical products at massive scale — operating one of the largest software platforms with millions of virtual machines, processing exabytes of data daily. At this scale, we regularly encounter cloud hardware, network, and operating system faults, and our software must gracefully shield customers from these challenges.

The Impact You Will Have

- Own the product or infrastructure direction of a major area and drive it to the next level with clear business impact and significantly increased adoption.
- Lead complex, multi-team technical projects end-to-end that have direct impact on the long-term success of a product line.
- Architect and deliver highly scalable, fault-tolerant systems that process massive volumes of data across thousands of customers.
- Drive organizational roadmap and technical direction through strong influence and strategic vision.
- Solve complex production issues wherever they occur, including low-level systems debugging and performance optimization on large-scale clusters.
- Act as a force multiplier by initiating and developing tools, processes, and best practices that boost productivity, security, and quality across the organization.
- Mentor senior engineers into effective technical leaders and contribute to recruiting top engineering talent.

What We Look For

- 10+ years of software engineering experience.
- Deep expertise building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production environments.

postings.title: Skills Systems Architect
postings.description:
FEQ227R209

About the Role

Databricks needs to understand what technical capability looks like across several large, fast-moving populations: employees, customers, and partners. Today that happens through role-based learning pathways and product-aligned enablement, an approach that can't keep pace with how quickly the platform, technology, and roles change. AI has also collapsed the half-life of technical proficiency, and for the first time, it makes a living, self-maintaining model of capability possible.

In this builder role, you'll own systems for defining, measuring, and developing technical capability across Databricks learner audiences. You'll build a capability model that ties roles, skills, content, and credentials together and the instrumentation that shows where capability actually stands.

What You'll Own

Skills taxonomies, capability models, and learning context

- Define the skills taxonomies that make up technical capability and shape how they’re organized; what skills exist, which are adjacent, which are prerequisites, how quickly they go stale, and what sources are available to learners for developing and maintaining them.

Observability and measurement

- Stand up instrumentation and AI-informed signals that show where capability stands and where it's drifting. Develop live signals, not a quarterly or monthly health index, to show how skills are moving and evolving.

- Anticipate where capability demand is heading. Product releases, market shifts, and role evolution are constant; track changes closely so emerging skills surface early and content and programs stay ahead of change.

AI-native tooling

- Build the software that maintains the skills taxonomy and capability model, including LLM-driven skill extraction and organization, agentic pipelines that keep them current, automated drift and gap detection, and APIs that expose it all.

- Make the model reusable enterprise context that other systems, teams, and products build on vs. a training-only asset.

Impact You'll Have

You will sit upstream of and across several teams and functions:

- Anywhere skills show up in products: You define what technical capability means and what evidence counts, so wherever skills are inferred, captured, or recognized, it reflects real technical work and skills & abilities.

- Content and curriculum. The skills taxonomy and capability model influence what gets built next and why. Learning context is a critical input to generative content.

- Learning architecture and in-product training: Your work informs what learning belongs where and how it’s presented. Pathways are assembled with the model and taxonomy instead of mapped by hand; in-product training surfaces them to learners.

- Certification & accreditation. The capability model grounds skills assessment to guide and accelerate exam developers.

- Learning & enablement. You give the organization a current view of capability across every audience, and a shared model to build and plan against.

What We're Looking For

- Experience in technical training, learning, enablement, or product education in data & AI, cloud, or comparable product categories.

- Experience designing capability or skills models and the systems around them, spanning modeling, measurement, and instrumentation.

- A builder mindset. Ability to use Python and SQL and build apps, with AI assistance, and wire up pipelines and stand up tooling yourself.

- AI-native. AI tooling is how you build and reason, from extraction and assessment to agentic workflows and evaluation. You understand when to reach for AI and when not.

- A track record of moving strategy as an IC through analysis and clear writing.

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with off-the-shelf skills-intelligence tooling and build-vs-buy tradeoffs.

- Experience instrumenting capability data across several audiences.

What Success Looks Like in Year One

- A live skills taxonomy, capability model, and learning context resources are published, and content, learning, and certification teams plan against them.

- Decisions about what to build, refresh, or retire leverage the skills taxonomy and capability model, so content better keeps pace with the product, and investment goes where capability demand and skill gaps are real.

- In-product training uses the model to target and measure learning, so learners can see what moves them forward, and stakeholders get insight into skills attainment within their audiences.

- Teams that bring skills into products work from the same model, so a skill means the same thing wherever someone encounters it.

postings.title: Software Engineer - Database Engine Internals
postings.description:
P-1414

Our mission at Databricks is to radically simplify the whole data lifecycle from ingestion to ETL, BI, and all the way up to ML/AI with a unified platform. To achieve this goal, we believe the data warehouse architecture as we know it today will be replaced by a new architectural pattern, Lakehouse (CIDR 2021 paper), open platforms that unify data warehousing and advanced analytics. This new architecture will help address several major challenges, including data staleness, reliability, total cost of ownership, data lock-in, and limited use-case support.

To achieve this vision, Databricks is building the next generation (decoupled) query engine and structured storage system that can outperform specialized data warehouses in relational query performance. Yet we will retain the expressiveness and robustness of general purpose systems such as Apache Spark™ to support diverse workloads ranging from ETL to data science. You will be part of this multi-year journey.

As part of this team, you will design these next-generation systems that leapfrog state-of-the-art within the following areas:

- Query compilation and optimization

- Distributed query execution and scheduling

- Vectorized execution engine

- Data security

- Resource management

- Transaction coordination

- Efficient storage structures (encodings, indexes)

- Automatic physical data optimization

The responsibilities you will have:

- Drive requirements clarity and design decisions for ambiguous problems

- Produce technical design documents and project plans

- Develop new features

- Mentor more junior engineers

- Test and rollout to production, monitoring.

What we look for:

- A passion for database systems, storage systems, distributed systems, language design, or performance optimization

- Are comfortable working towards a multi-year vision with incremental deliverables

- Be customer-oriented and focused on having an impact

- 5+ years of experience working in a related system

postings.description:
GAQ327R264

At Databricks Information Technology, we are a product-led organization transforming the way we work, from how easy it is to use our IT services to the applications we develop to help us scale seamlessly amid incredible growth.

As a Software Engineer, Infrastructure, you will be a core technical contributor on the IT CorpEng Infrastructure team, owning and driving the evolution of our core infrastructure and observability platforms. This role requires a strong software engineering mindset, deep technical breadth across SRE and infrastructure worlds, and the ability to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions for currently "immature" system problems. You will be responsible for building resilient, scalable, and automated infrastructure that empowers our development teams. As a member of the team, you will bridge the gap between software engineering and systems architecture, ensuring our AWS environment is cost-optimized, secure, and highly available.

The Impact You Will Have

- Automate: Develop and deploy production-grade infrastructure on cloud platforms (AWS preferred) using Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform or Pulumi.

- Orchestration: Deploy, manage, and scale containerized workloads using Kubernetes (EKS/AKS), focusing on security, reliability, and resource efficiency.

- CI/CD Excellence: Build and maintain robust deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, including both cloud-hosted and self-hosted runners for specialized build requirements.

- Drive "Observable by Default" Frameworks: Implement infrastructure standards to ensure new internal applications are secure, with logging, metrics, and tracing configured out of the box.

- Tooling, Scripting & AI: Build internal CLI tools, AI-assisted workflows, and automation scripts to streamline developer workflows and reduce manual toil.

- Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate with Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Support teams to execute technical projects aligned with business outcomes.

- Document & Knowledge Share: Participate in peer code reviews, maintain operational playbooks/failure triage guides, and help onboard team members onto platforms you maintain.

What We Look For

- Software Engineering Expertise: 3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, and tooling (required).

- Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Solid working knowledge of Terraform (modules, state management) or Pulumi (preferred).

- Cloud & Containerization: Hands-on experience building and supporting production workloads in AWS (or Azure/GCP), along with Kubernetes and Docker fundamentals.

- CI/CD & Automation: Practical experience designing, maintaining, and troubleshooting pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar modern CI/CD tools.

- Observability Foundations: Practical understanding of observability pillars (logging, metrics, tracing) and hands-on experience integrating tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana.

- Independent Execution: Proven ability to own end-to-end tasks with guidance from Tech Leads, breaking down broader technical goals into actionable technical solutions.

Software Engineer, Web Products

Location: Mountain View, CA

About Us:

The Web Engineering team at Databricks builds and owns the public-facing web experiences that represent Databricks to the world, across databricks.com, the blog, landing pages, hubs, microsites, and event properties. We are rebuilding the platform from the ground up, AI native from the start, and pioneering an agentic SDLC as our operating model.

As Software Engineer on the Web Engineering team, you will build and ship production-quality web experiences across public-facing Databricks properties on an AI native platform designed for humans and agents from the ground up. You will contribute to a web delivery practice where AI native tools and an AI native engineering lifecycle are embedded in how the team builds every day.

- Build and ship web experiences across databricks.com including landing pages, blogs, hubs, and event properties on a unified, AI native architectural foundation

- Operate in an AI native SDLC where agents assist across code generation, testing, and deployment, building faster and more reliably alongside them

- Contribute to ensuring databricks.com surfaces are structured and optimized for how the web is discovered and consumed today, including by AI driven search and discovery systems

- Participate actively in code review and help establish what rigorous, AI native engineering execution looks like on this team

- 4+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production web systems

- Strong fundamentals across the web stack including component architecture, rendering strategies, build systems, and deployment pipelines

- Comfort adopting AI native development tools and embedding them into daily engineering practice

- Ability to take a well-scoped problem and drive it to completion under senior direction

postings.title: Solutions Architect
postings.description:
(FEQ128R107)

The Role

As a Solutions Architect, you will lead the technical strategy for your customers - owning architecture discussions, driving platform adoption, and serving as a trusted advisor to customer technical leads and architects. You combine deep technical expertise with strategic thinking to position Databricks as the foundation of your customers’ data and AI strategy. You are developing a technical specialisation (archetype) and are recognised within your team for depth in a specific domain.

This role sits within our sales organisation and is ideal for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of business, data, and AI - and who is motivated by turning ideas into working solutions.

The Impact You Will Have

- Own the end-to-end technical strategy for your accounts, partnering with Account Executives from initial discovery through production deployment and consumption growth to drive technical sales cycles and customer outcomes

- Lead complex architecture discussions, customer workshops, discovery sessions, and technical deep-dives across multiple stakeholders — designing scalable, production-grade solutions spanning data engineering, ML/AI, and real-time analytics

- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customer architects, engineering leads, and Directors

- Build and deliver proof-of-concepts, demos, and solution prototypes using real data to drive technical wins in competitive scenarios by demonstrating Databricks’ differentiation

- Develop and declare an emerging technical specialisation (archetype) — becoming a go-to resource for your team in that domain

- Orchestrate cross-functional resources (DSAs, SSAs, Partners) to deliver comprehensive solutions for complex customer needs

- Influence product direction by providing structured feedback on customer requirements and competitive gaps

- Contribute reusable assets, patterns, and best practices that accelerate adoption across customers

What We Look For

- 6+ years in solutions architecture, data engineering, technical pre-sales, or a senior hands-on technical role

- Strong coding proficiency in Python and SQL - you must demonstrate live coding, debugging, and solution-building skills - comfortable reasoning through code, explaining how it works, and adapting it when things don't behave as expected

- Strong technical foundation in distributed data systems and Lakehouse patterns powering modern AI workloads (feature engineering, training, and inference)

- Proficient skills on the Databricks Platform (or demonstrated ability to achieve proficiency rapidly) and a developing technical specialisation in a core area (e.g., real-time/streaming, ML/AI, data governance, migrations)

- Experience with production deployments on public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including infrastructure, security, and governance considerations

- Track record of driving platform adoption and consumption growth within accounts

- Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex architectures into business value for both technical and executive audiences

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience)

What Makes You Successful in This Role

- You are comfortable switching between business dialogue and technical execution

- You don't just describe solutions — you can build, validate, and iterate on them in practice

- You take ownership of technical challenges and push problems forward, even when things are not working as expected

- You apply structured thinking in discovery and connect requirements to scalable technical solutions

Nice to Have:

- Databricks certifications (Data Engineer, ML, Platform)

- Experience with competitive platforms (Snowflake, AWS native services, Azure, Fabric) - understanding the landscape you'll position against

- Background in a data/AI company or cloud provider

- Industry domain expertise (Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, Media, etc.)

As a Solutions Architect part of a Global Capability Center(GCC) focused Field Engineering team, you will shape the future of the Data and AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated Data and AI teams in the world, including Fortune 500 enterprises and global AI-forward SaaS customers operating globally. In this role, you will be deeply embedded with our named strategic accounts, serving as a trusted long-term technical advisor while also collaborating with internal sales, product, and engineering teams.

You will help our customers achieve tangible data-driven outcomes through the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, helping data teams complete projects and integrate our platform into their enterprise ecosystem. You'll grow as a leader in your field, while finding solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in data engineering, analytics, AI and data science.

Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with our most strategic global prospects and customers, partner with regional field teams across geographies, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.

The impact you will have

postings.title: Solutions Architect – Digital Sovereignty
postings.description:
FEQ128R99

Location: Germany (remote or from a Databricks office – anywhere in Germany) Languages: Fluent German and business-level English

At Databricks, we build the platform that makes data and AI usable across an entire organization. More and more of our customers in Germany – public sector, critical infrastructure (KRITIS), financial services, healthcare, defence and industry – need to keep control over where their data lives and who can access it. They want the full power of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform without giving up data residency, jurisdictional control or the option to switch providers.

As a Solutions Architect for Digital Sovereignty, you are the technical lead for this motion in Germany. You design sovereign data and AI architectures with customers, run proofs of concept end to end, and help our sovereign cloud partners and account teams turn a proven pattern into production workloads.

The impact you will have

- Act as the trusted technical advisor on digital sovereignty for strategic and regulated customers across Germany, from the first conversation with the CIO/CISO through to production.

- Design and validate sovereign reference architectures

- Run complex proofs of concept and pilots – performance, scalability, security and network connectivity tests with different data volumes – and translate the results into clear go/no-go recommendations.

- Work hand in hand with sovereign cloud and storage partners: joint solution design, enablement of partner technical teams, co-selling and joint customer workshops.

- Position Databricks clearly in the sovereignty discussion – CLOUD Act, GDPR, NIS2, DORA, BSI C5, EU Data Act, open formats and exit strategies – and articulate how our open architecture reduces lock-in compared with competing approaches.

- Feed field requirements back to Databricks Product and Engineering, and collaborate with Legal, Security and Compliance on customer questions.

- Build repeatable assets: reference architectures, demos, PoC playbooks, Terraform/automation templates and customer-facing collateral in German and English.

- Build Databricks' visibility on sovereignty in the German market through workshops, meetups, webinars and conference talks.

- Turn customer conversations into working prototypes fast, using AI-assisted development to build demos in hours rather than weeks.

What we look for

- Fluent German and business-level English. Both are used daily with customers, partners and internally.

- Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solution architecture or consulting, including complex enterprise customer interactions across the full sales lifecycle.

- Hands-on experience with data platforms in at least one major public cloud (Azure, AWS or GCP), ideally including Apache Spark and/or Databricks.

- Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure: networking (private connectivity, VPN, private endpoints), identity and access management, encryption and key management (BYOK/HYOK).

- Experience with object storage and open table formats (S3-compatible storage such as MinIO, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg) and with secure data sharing patterns.

- Good working knowledge of the regulatory and sovereignty landscape in Germany and the EU (e.g. GDPR, CLOUD Act implications, NIS2, DORA, BSI C5, KRITIS) and the ability to discuss it confidently with CISOs, data protection officers and procurement.

- Ability to drive technical and business conversations with C-level executives, orchestrate cross-functional and partner teams, and influence outcomes toward long-term customer success.

- Hands-on coding ability in Python and SQL; infrastructure-as-code experience (e.g. Terraform) is a plus.

- Daily, fluent use of AI tools in your own work. Coding assistants and agents are part of how you operate, not something you try out occasionally.

- Able to vibe-code a demo: assemble a credible, working prototype for a specific customer problem with AI assistance, and recognize where the output still needs your own judgment.

- Experience working with or for European / sovereign cloud providers, public sector or regulated industries is a strong plus.

- Judgment to prioritize the right use cases and investments, and to navigate a competitive landscape.

- Willingness to travel within Germany for customer and partner meetings.

Why this role

- You will shape a new, strategically important motion for Databricks in Germany and EMEA – building on a proof of concept that has already delivered results.

- You will work at the intersection of data and AI, cloud infrastructure, regulation and partnerships.

postings.title: Solutions Architect (Genie)
postings.location: Bengaluru, India; Delhi, India; India; Mumbai, India
postings.description:
FEQ327R421

Mission

The Solutions Architect (Genie) team executes on Databricks’ strategic Product Operating Model that provides enhanced focus on earlier stage, highly prioritized product lines in order to establish product market fit, and set the course for rapid revenue growth. They are part of a global go-to-market team mandate, though individually will cover a specific, local region. Clients may span across one or more business units and verticals. By working in partnership with direct account teams, they will jointly engage clients, foster the necessary relationships, position in-depth the specific product line, so as to provide compelling reasons for clients to adopt and grow the usage of the given product. They understand the appropriate approach, the guardrails, and the steps needed to successfully adopt the product line, as clients deliver on their business objectives.

The Solutions Architect (Genie) is paired with an Account Executive aligned to a given product line with specific targets accordingly. Together, they will devise and implement a strategy across their assigned set of accounts, develop presentations, demos and other assets and deliver them such that clients make an informed decision as they decide to adopt the product-line in a meaningful way.

The impact you will have

- Collaborate with GTM leadership and account teams to design and execute high-impact engagement strategies across your territory.

- As a trusted advisor, serve as an expert Solutions Architect and "champion," building technical credibility with stakeholders to drive product adoption and vision.

- Enable clients at scale through workshops and developing customer-facing collateral that helps increase technical knowledge and thought leadership.

- Influence product roadmap by translating field-derived, data-driven insights into strategic recommendations for Product and Engineering teams

- Handle the most complex technical challenges in this product line by acting as the tier-3 escalation point for the field, ensuring customer success in mission-critical environments.

Competencies & Responsibilities

- 6+ years in a customer-facing, pre-sales or consulting role influencing technical executives, driving high-level data strategy and product adoption.

- Credibility in influencing analytics, BI, and natural-language / agentic AI products, with the market insight needed to shape and prioritize roadmap capabilities.

- Deep understanding of AI governance across different tools and models and ability to guide customers through security blockers and concerns

- Proven ability to co-plan large territories with Account Executives and operate in a highly coordinated, cross-functional effort across GTM and R&D teams.

- Experience architecting governed analytics solutions that integrate semantic models, data warehouses, and metric layers within broader Lakehouse and AI ecosystems.

- Experience collaborating with Global System Integrators (GSIs) and third-party consulting organizations to drive customer outcomes.

- Proficient in programming, debugging, and problem-solving using SQL and Python.

- Hands-on experience building solutions within major public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

- Broad experience (in two or more) and understanding across the fields of data engineering, data warehousing, business intelligence, AI, ML, governance, semantic modeling, natural-language analytics, and streaming.

- Undergraduate degree (or higher) in a technical field such as Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or similar.

postings.title: Solutions Architect - Lakebase
postings.description:
Mission

The Solutions Architect (Lakebase) team executes on Databricks’ strategic Product Operating Model that provides enhanced focus on earlier stage, highly prioritized product lines in order to establish product market fit, and set the course for rapid revenue growth. They are part of a global go-to-market team mandate, though individually will cover a specific, local region. Clients may span across one or more business units and verticals. By working in partnership with direct account teams, they will jointly engage clients, foster the necessary relationships, position in-depth the specific product line, so as to provide compelling reasons for clients to adopt and grow the usage of the given product. They understand the appropriate approach, the guardrails, and the steps needed to successfully adopt the product line, as clients deliver on their business objectives.

The Solutions Architect (Lakebase) is paired with an Account Executive aligned to a given product line with specific targets accordingly. Together, they will devise and implement a strategy across their assigned set of accounts, develop presentations, demos and other assets and deliver them such that clients make an informed decision as they decide to adopt the product-line in a meaningful way.

The Lakebase product-line requires the following core technical competencies:

- 10+ years of transactional database (OLTP) expertise across engineering, product development, administration, and pre-sales, with a proven track record of designing and delivering client-facing solutions.

- Credibility in influencing OLTP products with the market insight needed to shape and prioritize roadmap capabilities.

- Experience architecting solutions that integrate transactional data systems within broader Big Data, Lakehouse, and AI ecosystems.

- Infrastructure, platform and administration expertise around disaster recovery, high availability, backup and recovery, scale-out methods, identity and security management, migrations (vendor-to-vendor, on-prem to cloud)

The impact you will have

- Collaborate with GTM leadership and account teams to design and execute high-impact engagement strategies across your territory.

- As a trusted advisor, serve as an expert Solutions Architect and "champion," building technical credibility with stakeholders to drive product adoption and vision.

- Enable clients at scale through workshops and developing customer-facing collateral that helps increase technical knowledge and thought leadership.

- Influence product roadmap by translating field-derived, data-driven insights into strategic recommendations for Product and Engineering teams

- Handle the most complex technical challenges in this product line by acting as the tier-3 escalation point for the field, ensuring customer success in mission-critical environments.

Competencies & Responsibilities

- 6+ years in a customer-facing, pre-sales or consulting role influencing technical executives, driving high-level data strategy and product adoption.

- Proven ability to co-plan large territories with Account Executives and operate in a highly coordinated, cross-functional effort across GTM and R&D teams.

- Experience collaborating with Global System Integrators (GSIs) and third-party consulting organizations to drive customer outcomes.

- Proficient in programming, debugging, and problem-solving using SQL and Python.

- Hands-on experience building solutions within major public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

- Broad experience (in two or more) and understanding across the fields of data engineering, data warehousing, AI, ML, governance, transactional systems, app development, and streaming.

- Undergraduate degree (or higher) in a technical field such as Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or similar.

- A track record of driving complex projects to completion in fast-paced, customer-facing environments.

postings.description:
The Solutions Architect (Lakebase) team executes on Databricks’ strategic Product Operating Model that provides enhanced focus on earlier stage, highly prioritised product lines in order to establish product market fit, and set the course for rapid revenue growth. They are part of a global go-to-market team mandate, though individually will cover a specific, local region. Clients may span across one or more business units and verticals. By working in partnership with direct account teams, they will jointly engage clients, foster the necessary relationships, position in-depth the specific product line, so as to provide compelling reasons for clients to adopt and grow the usage of the given product. They understand the appropriate approach, the guardrails, and the steps needed to successfully adopt the product line, as clients deliver on their business objectives.

The Solutions Architect (Lakebase) is paired with an Account Executive aligned to a given product line with specific targets accordingly. Together, they will devise and implement a strategy across their assigned set of accounts, develop presentations, demos and other assets and deliver them such that clients make an informed decision as they decide to adopt the product-line in a meaningful way.

The Lakebase product-line requires the following core technical competencies:

- Deep of transactional database (OLTP) expertise across engineering, product development, administration, and pre-sales, with a proven track record of designing and delivering client-facing solutions.

- Credibility in influencing OLTP products with the market insight needed to shape and prioritise roadmap capabilities.

- Experience architecting solutions that integrate transactional data systems within broader Big Data, Lakehouse, and AI ecosystems.

- Infrastructure, platform and administration expertise around disaster recovery, high availability, backup and recovery, scale-out methods, identity and security management, migrations (vendor-to-vendor, on-prem to cloud)

The impact you will have

- Collaborate with GTM leadership and account teams to design and execute high-impact engagement strategies across your territory.

- As a trusted advisor, serve as an expert Solutions Architect and "champion," building technical credibility with stakeholders to drive product adoption and vision.

- Enable clients at scale through workshops and developing customer-facing collateral that helps increase technical knowledge and thought leadership.

- Influence product roadmap by translating field-derived, data-driven insights into strategic recommendations for Product and Engineering teams

- Handle the most complex technical challenges in this product line by acting as the tier-3 escalation point for the field, ensuring customer success in mission-critical environments.

 Competencies & Responsibilities

- Experienced in a customer-facing, pre-sales or consulting role influencing technical executives, driving high-level data strategy and product adoption.

- Proven ability to co-plan large territories with Account Executives and operate in a highly coordinated, cross-functional effort across GTM and R&D teams.

- Experience collaborating with Global System Integrators (GSIs) and third-party consulting organisations to drive customer outcomes.

- Proficient in programming, debugging, and problem-solving using SQL and Python.

- Hands-on experience building solutions within major public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

- Broad experience (in two or more) and understanding across the fields of data engineering, data warehousing, AI, ML, governance, transactional systems, app development, and streaming.

- Undergraduate degree (or higher) in a technical field such as Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or similar.

- A track record of driving complex projects to completion in fast-paced, customer-facing environments.

postings.description:
Location: Tokyo, Japan
Req ID: FEQ427R141
Reporting to: Manager, Field Engineering
Language requirements: Business-professional Japanese required; business-level English preferred

Mission

As a Pre-sales Solutions Architect focused on Manufacturing and Automotive, you will engage with leading global automotive manufacturers and strategic industry accounts across Japan. In partnership with Account Executives, Solutions Architects, technology specialists, partners, and customer teams, you will develop and execute technical strategies that help customers adopt the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform and achieve measurable business outcomes.

You will translate complex automotive and manufacturing challenges into scalable data and AI solutions across vehicle platforms, connected-vehicle analytics, vehicle and component quality, supply-chain optimization, smart manufacturing, engineering and R&D analytics, aftersales, customer intelligence, and AI-powered applications. You will operate with a builder mindset, creating hands-on prototypes, demonstrations, and proof points that accelerate customer confidence and adoption.

The impact you will have

- Develop and execute customer engagement strategies in partnership with Account Executives and Solutions Architects for strategic automotive and manufacturing accounts.

- Lead complex customer engagements across the full technical pre-sales lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution scoping, architecture design, workshops, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and implementation planning.

- Coach account teams and peers on positioning, adoption strategies, use-case prioritization, and execution plans that deliver outcomes within a defined timeline.

- Influence stakeholders at all levels, from data practitioners and engineers to manufacturing leaders and C-level executives, by connecting technical decisions to business value.

- Act as a champion and trusted advisor for customers and colleagues on data, analytics, machine learning, generative AI, architecture, design, and Databricks adoption.

- Integrate Databricks with cloud services, enterprise platforms, and third-party applications to support customer architectures.

- Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Services, Customer Success, Partners, Marketing, Sales, and Field Engineering to represent customer needs and accelerate adoption.

- Lead workshops, seminars, meetups, and other community activities to build technical awareness and scale best practices in Japan.

What we look for

- Experience engaging with complex customers and sales lifecycles in a technical pre-sales, consulting, technical architecture, or equivalent role.

- A technical background in data engineering, data warehousing, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or related fields.

- Experience designing and implementing solutions on public cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, or GCP.

- Hands-on expertise delivering complex proof-of-concepts and technical demonstrations.

- Ability to code in Python or SQL and willingness to learn or deepen knowledge of Apache Spark™; experience with Scala, Java, or R is beneficial.

- Strong understanding of enterprise data platforms, distributed data systems, analytics, machine learning, generative AI, or modern cloud architectures.

- Demonstrated ability to provide technical solutions for specialized customer needs and navigate a competitive landscape.

- Ability to influence decision-makers and C-level executives by building relationships and orchestrating cross-functional teams toward long-term customer success.

- Builder mindset with a track record of prototyping, creating demos, and crafting tailored solutions for ambiguous or challenging customer environments.

- Strong communication, presentation, whiteboarding, and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.

- Experience working with enterprise customers and building trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.

- Strong collaboration skills and the ability to partner effectively with Account Executives, Solutions Architects, specialists, and other cross-functional teams.

- Business-professional fluency in Japanese; business-level English proficiency is preferred.

Preferred experience

- Experience working with leading automotive manufacturers, automotive suppliers, industrial companies, transportation providers, or mobility businesses.

- Familiarity with vehicle platforms, connected vehicles, vehicle telemetry, smart factories, industrial IoT, supply-chain analytics, quality and warranty analytics, engineering/R&D, aftersales, EVs, or battery analytics.

- Experience with Databricks, Apache Spark™, MLflow, Delta Lake, lakehouse architectures, or comparable data and AI platforms.

- Experience coaching or mentoring other technical professionals or account teams.

postings.description:
FEQ128R31

Solutions Engineer

At Databricks, our core values drive everything we do; a culture of proactiveness and a customer-first mindset fuels our mission to create a unified platform that makes AI and data analytics accessible to everyone in their own context. This role is part of our programmatic effort to develop promising field engineers—offering a launchpad for the next generation of data leaders. We aim to build leaders who will drive both data and business strategy for our customers, leading the front lines of Databricks growth as well.

With our Data Intelligence Platform, we make it easy to turn insights into action while encouraging creativity, experimentation, and continuous improvement. You’ll play a key role in this mission, building upon your emerging technical skills in the area of solutions engineering, learn how to apply them in the Databricks platform and show customers how to tackle real-world data challenges. Solutions engineers go further than telling them what's possible; they build working prototypes and advise customer teams on how to get to production. You’ll join a collaborative, customer-obsessed team that thrives on innovation to help customers reach their goals. Come help us change how the world works with data—and shape your future while you're at it!

This will be an in-office role and candidates must be based in Chicago, IL. Relocation assistance will not be provided.

Recent graduate?: We’d love for you to explore our current internship openings on our careers page and submit your application for our roles designed for new college graduates.

More About Databricks

YouTube

The impact you will have:

- Form successful relationships with customers throughout your assigned territory, providing technical and business value to Databricks customers in collaboration with Account Executives.

- Operate as an expert in AI and data analytics to excite customers about Databricks. You will develop into a ‘champion’ and trusted advisor on multiple areas of architecture, design, and implementation to lead to the successful adoption of the Databricks data and AI platform.

- Adopt a builder-first approach: move quickly from customer problem to working prototype by writing code, building demos, and creating reusable assets that accelerate customer outcomes. 

- Use AI tools to increase your productivity and drive innovation.

- Scale best practices in your field and support customers by authoring reference architectures, how-tos, demo applications, and help build the Databricks community in your region by leading workshops, seminars, and meet-ups.

- Grow your knowledge and expertise to the level of a technical and/or industry specialist.

What we look for:

- The ideal candidate has 2+ years of technical experience in a customer-facing solutions engineering role.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience

- Demonstrates a builder mindset: preference for hands-on prototyping and learning-by-doing, with comfort using AI-assisted development tools to move faster

- Hands-on experience with Python, Java, or Scala, and proficiency in SQL
